attorneys.name: Jeffrey Abney
attorneys.practice_type: Domestic Relations Lawyers in Hillsboro, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jeffrey Abney joined Roberts, Wooten, and Zimmer in 2025. He received his J.D. from the University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law in 2021 and received B.A. in Legal Studies from Webster University in 2018 as well as a B.S. in Business Administration from Columbia College in 2012. Jeffrey is licensed to practice law in the State of Missouri. Jeffrey’s legal practice focuses on Domestic Relations and Family law.

During his time in law school, Jeffrey focused on consumer advocacy and completed two clinics at the Maryland Attorney Generals Office in their Consumer Protection Division. He also was lucky enough to testify in front of the Maryland State Assembly and State Senate advocating for legislation his consumer protection class drafted which would change a racially disparate law pertaining to body attachments and civil debts. Jeffrey was the President of the University of Maryland Association of Legislative Law (UMALL) and the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) while in law school. Jeffrey won the CALI award for Consumer Protection in 2019, the University of Maryland Community Scholar Prize for Justice Based Scholarship in 2021, and the University of Maryland Public Service Award in 2021. Prior to his legal career, Jeffrey served honorably in the United States Army.

He is the father of three children and in his free time he enjoys reading, playing pickleball, shooting pool, and watching movies.

attorneys.name: David K. Adam
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Law, Contracts Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
David represents corporate and individual clients in a wide range of matters such as contracts, leases, employee disputes, mergers, insurance and related litigation. He has helped companies achieve benefits via appeals related to property and manufacturer taxes, sales/use and excise taxes along with consultation regarding registration and license matters. David can also defend against challenges initiated by State, Local and Federal tax departments in tax compliance controversies. He has served in corporate roles including those of Accounting Controller, Business Owner, Chief Financial Officer, and State and Local Tax Consultant. As a result, he appreciates what consumers of legal services seek. David has also served as a Board Member for various charitable and corporate entities in numerous industries.

David implements an interdisciplinary approach to his clients' legal matters by working closely with their client's executives, in-house counsel, operating personnel and other consultants. He also staffs matters with other attorneys at UGBB to leverage diverse experiences in business litigation, personal injury, divorce, real estate, trusts, wills and probate estates for purposes of planning and resolving disputes. David's varied experience combined with a spirit of collaboration, allow him to bring a comprehensive perspective to his clients' cases. As one of the firm's partners, he seeks practical, cost-effective resolutions, while keeping in mind the long-term implications of each matter.

attorneys.name: Amir Ardebili
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Amir Ardebili has always been a champion of social justice, and spends his time vigorously advocating for the rights of individuals. As a founding partner of Hubbard & Ardebili, LLC, Amir fought for victims of discrimination and wage and hour violations, for consumers who were victims of fraud and deceptive practices, and for those injured by the negligence of others. Now, as of counsel at Monsees & Mayer, P.C., Amir continues his efforts to restore the rights of individuals. His primary areas of practice are employment law, consumer protection, business litigation, legal malpractice, personal injury, and criminal defense. Amir has also done considerable pro bono work defending the rights of those who are unable to obtain legal representation.

Amir was born and raised in the Kansas City Metropolitan area. After graduating from Blue Valley Northwest High School, Amir continued on to the University of Missouri at Kansas City to earn his bachelors of science in Sociology while working at the civil engineering firm, SK Design Group, LLC. Amir earned his Juris Doctor at the UMKC School of Law and is now a member of the Missouri bar and the United States District Court of the Western District of Missouri.

attorneys.name: Steven M. Aroesty
attorneys.practice_type: Pharmaceutical and Medical Products Litigation Lawyers in Webster Groves, MO
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Aroesty joined OnderLaw in 2022 following more than 30 years’ experience representing countless plaintiffs in personal injury cases, including asbestos-related cancer claims, dangerous pharmaceuticals, defective medical devices and other individual and mass tort claims. He is outstanding among his peers in conducting depositions, arguing motions and negotiating settlements.

Steve earned his undergraduate degree from Cornell University in upstate New York, where he was a New York State Regents Scholar. He earned his Juris Doctor from Washington University School of Law in St. Louis, Missouri where he was a recipient of the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis Judge Ruddy Scholarship, a champion of the Client Counseling Competition and an elected representative of the Student Bar Association.

Steve’s extensive legal experience includes employment with two major insurance carriers as well as with an insurance defense firm along with commercial collection and banking work. This experience on the defense side of litigation makes him particularly adept at arguing on behalf of personal injury plaintiffs.

Steve is Martindale Hubbell AV Preeminent Rated and has been since 2009.

Steve is licensed to practice in Missouri, Illinois, New York and the District of Columbia, along with Federal Courts in the Southern and Northern Districts of Illinois, the Eastern District of Missouri, along with the Seventh and Eighth Circuits of the U.S. Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Dee Arrington
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Dee comes to Case Linden with extensive experience in federal and state courts. Most recently, she clerked for the Honorable Chief Judge Cynthia A. Norton in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Missouri. Dee served as an intern to the Honorable Duane Benton at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit and Magistrate Judge Willie J. Epps, Jr. at the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri. She also interned for Missouri state court judges Joshua C. Devine and Kayla Jackson-Williams of the 13th Judicial Circuit Court. Dee’s work for these courts and judges makes her a strong litigator, attentive to how judges evaluate evidence, apply the law, and decide matters in both trial and appellate settings.

Her private practice experience prior to joining the firm includes substantive work on cases involving workplace disputes (including allegations of discrimination, wage theft and wrongful termination), contract disputes, construction litigation, and bodily injury cases.

Prior to law school, Dee spent over a decade as a corporate human resources and business consultant with a primary focus on disputes between employees and employers, compliance, investigations and training. This background provides her with a well-grounded, practical perspective in defending employment litigation and engaging in dispute resolution.

During her time at the University of Missouri School of Law, Dee earned first place in both the Board of Advocates Client Interview Competition and the Jim H. Levin Mediation Competition. She also earned a Certificate in Dispute Resolution while completing her legal studies. Most recently, Dee earned a Certificate in Mass Tort Multi-District Litigation at the Bolch Judicial Institute of Duke Law School.

attorneys.name: Ashley Atwell
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
My practice is focused on representing individuals in Employment Discrimination and Personal Injury matters. Following law school, I spent several years working at a large civil defense firm where I represented corporate clients. I put the knowledge and expertise I gained working on ‘the other side' to use in order to better advocate for my clients, and find great satisfaction in helping each of my clients to achieve a fair outcome to their case. I have experience at all phases of litigation, including first and second chair trial experience, and I enjoy working with clients of all backgrounds. As a fluent Spanish-speaker, I am uniquely suited to represent Spanish speaking clients. I also frequently co-counsel with other law firms on personal injury, products liability, or employment discrimination matters involving Spanish-speaking clients or witnesses.

I also serve as appointed counsel under the Criminal Justice Act for clients facing federal criminal charges in the United States District Court for the Western District of Missouri.

Before entering private practice, I served as a law clerk for the Honorable Dean Whipple of the Western District of Missouri, where I assisted Judge Whipple at every phase of both civil and criminal litigation. Before law school, I worked in Washington, D.C. as Press Secretary for United States Congressman Silvestre Reyes and the Congressional Hispanic Caucus.

I am a certified Spanish- language Court Interpreter and have lived and travelled throughout Latin America and Spain.

attorneys.name: Andrea Baca
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Andrea Baca brings a strong foundation in complex litigation and eDiscovery to Long & Robinson, LLC, where she serves as an essential member of the firm’s legal team. Andrea focuses her practice on complex litigation support, electronic discovery management, and commercial real estate matters, applying a detail-oriented and solutions-driven approach to each project. She also recently became a certified mediator in Missouri, further expanding her ability to assist clients in resolving disputes efficiently and effectively.

Andrea plays a central role in managing third-party subpoenas and coordinating electronic document productions for Fortune 500 commercial real estate companies. She oversees the full lifecycle of eDiscovery—from data collection and analysis to review, production, and deposition preparation—ensuring compliance with legal requirements while protecting clients’ strategic and business interests. Her ability to navigate large-scale document environments and tight deadlines makes her a trusted resource for both attorneys and client representatives.

Before joining Long & Robinson, LLC, Andrea gained significant experience in complex pharmaceutical litigation, where she developed deep proficiency in managing high-volume document reviews, assessing privilege and confidentiality issues, and coordinating production protocols across multiple jurisdictions. This background strengthened her expertise in the technical and procedural aspects of eDiscovery, which she now leverages to support a diverse range of commercial and construction-related matters.

Andrea is known for her meticulous attention to detail, strong communication skills, and ability to streamline complex processes. Her recent certification as a mediator complements her litigation support work, offering clients an additional pathway to navigate and resolve disputes.

Outside the office, Andrea enjoys continuing her professional development in emerging eDiscovery technologies and trends, as well as spending time with family and pursuing her personal interests.

attorneys.bio:
Donald A. Baerveldt, Jr. is licensed to practice law in the State of Missouri, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri, the United States Court of Appeals 8th Circuit and the United States Supreme Court. Mr. Baerveldt received his undergraduate degree from Benedictine College (Cum Laude 1984) with majors in both Accounting and Business Administration. Mr. Baerveldt received his law degree from St. Louis University (J.D. 1987). He is a member of the Missouri Bar and the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis.

Mr. Baerveldt has been practicing law in St. Charles County, Missouri since 1988, with his areas of practice primarily in the areas of Estate Planning, Probate, Probate Litigation and Trust Litigation, Business and Succession Planning, Personal Injury, Workers Compensation, Criminal and Traffic Law. Mr. Baerveldt’s practice encompasses the counties of St. Charles, St. Louis, Lincoln, Warren, Franklin and Jefferson and metropolitan St. Louis. Mr. Baerveldt offers a free initial client consultation. Client fees are billed at a competitive hourly rate or charged as a flat fee depending upon the nature of the case. Contingent fees are charged in personal injury and workers compensation matters as well as limited other matters offered on a case by case basis.

Mr. Baerveldt is married (Susan) with two daughters (Katie and Kelly). He and his wife are active in local select softball leagues as coaches of the 18U St. Louis Vipers. Mr. Baerveldt enjoys playing baseball as a member of the St. Louis MBSL 35 Black Sox, playing softball in various men’s leagues in the St. Louis area, and running.

attorneys.name: Sally E. Barker
attorneys.practice_type: Private and Public Sector Labor Unions Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Sally Barker received her law degree from St. Louis University (J.D., cum laude) in 1976 where she served as Editor of the Law Journal. She focuses on Private and Public Sector Labor Unions and Individual Employment Law matters. She represented the prevailing unions in Independence National Education Association v. Independence School District, in which the Missouri Supreme Court held that public employees have a state constitutional right to engage in collective bargaining. Subsequently, she has represented police and teacher unions in negotiating first labor agreements and litigation to enforce their collective bargaining rights. Sally is a co-author of Federal and State Law Governing Public Employees, 2008, Missouri Bar, (and earlier editions of that publication) and frequently gives speeches on a variety of labor and employment law subjects, including the union's role in responding to sexual harassment complaints and Missouri public sector labor law. She is a member (former Board member of the AFL-CIO’s Union Lawyers Alliance. She was the recipient of the 2001 Daily Record "Woman Lawyer of the Year" award, elected to the College of Labor and Employment Lawyers, and has been listed in the publications, Kansas/Missouri Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers in America for a number of years. In 2015 and 2016, she was listed as one of Missouri’s top 50 women lawyers and has received the highest possible rating from Martindale-Hubbell at AV Preeminent. In January 2019, Sally was inducted into the Saint Louis University School of Law Order of the Fleur de Lis Hall of Fame.

Sally has an interest in mental health issues both from a legal and also philanthropic standpoint. She served on the Board of Directors of Mental Health of America of Eastern Missouri (“MHA”). She has received awards for her efforts to improve mental health care from MHA and the St. Louis Gateway Center for Giving.

attorneys.name: Jordan Barry Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Going through a divorce or family law matter can be difficult and emotional. Having a dedicated attorney in your corner can lighten that load and provide peace of mind. Jordan Barry is a compassionate Junior Associate Attorney at Stange Law Firm. Based in our Clayton, Missouri office, Jordan is prepared to represent clients in St. Louis County and surrounding areas.

Jordan attended Southern University Law Center in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, where she received her Juris Doctor in May 2023. Prior to law school, Jordan earned her Bachelor of Arts in Communication from Clark Atlanta University in Atlanta, Georgia.

Before joining the Clayton, MO divorce and family law attorneys at Stange Law Firm, Jordan most recently served as an E-Discovery Doc Reviewer at a legal consulting and e-discovery firm specializing in technology-enabled services for litigation, investigations, and regulatory compliance. Jordan’s earlier experience includes roles as a District Attorney Legal Assistant for Fulton County in Atlanta, GA and a Legal Assistant for a law firm in Decatur, GA. In these positions, she supported attorneys, conducted in-dept surveillance on several matters, and managed files and client communications. Through her experience, Jordan has developed strong investigative and communicative skills, and she is ready to apply them to your family law matter.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Bart Baumstark
attorneys.practice_type: Mesothelioma and Asbestos Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Bart joined the O’Brien Law Firm in 2003. Before joining the O’Brien Law Firm, he worked as a criminal prosecutor in St. Louis City and later represented the interests of injured railroad workers and their families. Bart serves as the firm’s lead trial attorney and settlement negotiator in asbestos cases.

The vast majority of Bart’s experience as a trial lawyer has been in St. Louis courts. Before joining the O’Brien Law Firm, he successfully tried cases to juries involving repetitive trauma injuries ($900,000 verdict), catastrophic ear injury ($2,500,000 verdict), felony drug and weapon offenses, criminal assaults, robberies, and home invasions. He takes special pride in his knowledge of and experience with St. Louis area courts, judges, and juries.

Bart’s work on behalf of asbestos victims is not limited to the courtroom. He regularly testifies on behalf of Missouri asbestos victims at House and Senate committee hearings in Jefferson City in an effort to stop “tort reform” legislation from infringing on the rights of the firm’s clients. He also helps draft and advocate for the adoption of legislation to protect the rights of Missouri asbestos victims. Bart helped draft portions of the Missouri law enacted in 2014 that provided enhanced financial compensation for mesothelioma and asbestosis victims through the Workers’ Compensation claim system.

He currently serves on the board of governors for the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys (MATA).

Bart often presents at continuing legal education seminars and professional gatherings on Missouri asbestos and mesothelioma law.

A 1996 honors graduate of the Saint Louis University Law School, Bart received the American Jurisprudence Award in Evidence and Trial Advocacy and served as a member of the Moot Court Board and Law Review. He lives in University City with his wife Meghan and their two children.

Bart is licensed to practice in Missouri and Illinois state and federal courts.

attorneys.name: Timothy J. Becker
attorneys.practice_type: Truck Crashes Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
During his nearly 30-year legal career, Tim Becker has become known and revered as one of this nation’s leading truck crash attorneys. Through his work at Dollar, Burns, Becker & Hershewe, Tim has litigated truck crashes cases in 38 of the 50 states and won millions of dollars in settlements for his clients.

For Tim, the settlements are not what matters. It’s being able to provide comfort and hope for the families of truck crash victims. “I have spent my entire legal career dealing with families who have lost loved ones, often days after it happened.”

“When we first meet the families,” Becker says, “they are at the absolute lowest point of their lives. As we figure out how and why the unthinkable occurred, we see them come around and have that hope and sense of purpose back, pursuing the case to prevent it from happening to another family.”

He works alongside the other truck crash attorneys at Dollar, Burns, Becker & Hershewe, to alter laws at the local, state and national level as well as truck company policies and procedures to ensure these types of accidents don’t happen again in the future.

attorneys.name: Mark J. Becker
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Webster Groves, MO
attorneys.bio:
Mark Becker is an esteemed attorney with a wealth of experience and a strong commitment to legal excellence. With admissions to the Missouri Bar in 1991 and the Illinois Bar in 1992, Mark has established himself as a trusted legal advocate in both jurisdictions. He is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court, Eastern District of Missouri since 1991.

Mark obtained his Juris Doctor from the University of Missouri Columbia in 1990, building a strong foundation of legal knowledge and skills. Prior to his law degree, he earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (B.S.B.A.) from the University of Missouri Columbia in 1987, further enhancing his understanding of the business world and its intersections with the law.

As an active member of various legal associations, Mark stays at the forefront of his profession and contributes to the legal community. His memberships include the Missouri Bar Association, Illinois State Bar Association, American Bar Association, Association of Trial Lawyers of America, Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys (Board of Governors, 2002 – 2010), Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis, Lawyers Association of St. Louis, and the American Association for Justice.

Mark’s dedication to upholding the highest ethical standards in the legal profession led to his appointment by the Missouri Supreme Court to the Lawyers Regional Disciplinary Committee, where he served from 2009 to 2019. This appointment highlights his commitment to maintaining professional integrity and ensuring accountability within the legal community.

Beyond his legal practice, Mark actively engages in various community endeavors. He served on the Board of Directors for St. Vincent Home for Children from 2000 to 2008 and held the position of Chairman of the Board from 2003 to 2005. Additionally, Mark served as President of St. Vincent’s Home for Children from 2005 to 2007, contributing to the well-being and growth of the organization.

Mark’s dedication to public service extends to his role as the Mayor of the City of Des Peres, a position he has held since 2018. His re-election in 2020 and 2022 reflects the trust and confidence the community places in his leadership abilities.

Throughout his career, Mark has consistently demonstrated exceptional legal skills and a commitment to providing outstanding service to his clients. His AV Rating of Excellent, awarded since 1999, speaks to his high level of professional competence and ethical standards. Furthermore, Mark’s inclusion in prestigious publications such as Best Lawyers in America for 2021, 2022, and 2023, as well as Best Lawyers in America, Judicial Edition for 2023, underscores his reputation as a highly respected attorney in his practice areas.

With a diverse range of legal experience and a passion for making a difference in his community, Mark Becker exemplifies the qualities of an exceptional attorney. His dedication to his clients, his commitment to professional integrity, and his active involvement in various legal and community organizations make him an invaluable asset to the legal field.

attorneys.name: Victor A. Bergman
attorneys.practice_type: Automobile Accidents Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Victor A. Bergman represents ordinary America citizens against the powerful.

If he believes your case has merit, if he is convinced your case is provable, he'll fight for you. Once he chooses you, he becomes relentlessly committed to winning your case.

Vic limits the number of cases he takes. Where other trial attorneys may handle scores or hundreds of cases at the same time, Vic files about 10 at any given time. He limits his caseload to ensure that your case receives the time, resources, and the experts it needs to deliver the results you deserve.

Vic's results speak for themselves. His peers have placed Vic on the list of "America’s Best Lawyers" every year since 1987. They picked him as one of the region's "Super Lawyers" since that designation began in 2005. He was inducted in the American College of Trial Lawyers in 1998, limited to the top 1% of trial lawyers nationwide.

Vic handles every type of personal injury case, the common element being a severe injury or death.

Vic has extensive experience and success in trucking accident cases. In Disidore v. Mail Contractors of America, Inc., Unitran, Inc., Hoovestol, Inc., Holland Hitch Company and The United States, Vic won a $5 million settlement after jury selection in federal court. His client sustained a traumatic brain injury when a semi truck unexpectedly disconnected the second of two 45' trailers it was pulling on I-70. The disconnected trailer smashed into his client’s car, leaving her with permanent brain injury. The trucking company blamed the maintenance company which blamed the fifth wheel manufacturer, so Vic made claims against them all.

For 30 years Vic has had a special interest in representing children and their families in obstetrical malpractice and other birth injury cases. In court he's proven the connection between medical malpractice around the time of birth and cerebral palsy and death.

Vic obtained a verdict of $15 million in Olsen v. Humana, Inc., et al., a case arising from the mismanagement of labor and delivery by nurses and an obstetrician. He won a verdict of $12.9 million in another birth injury case, Jones v. Humana. He has favorable settlements in many other birth injury cases.

Vic's successes in personal injury law are broad and in some cases historical.

Vic was a national figure in the legal fight for women who were injured, and for the families of those killed by Toxic Shock Syndrome. In court, Vic proved the correlation between Toxic Shock Syndrome and the use of highly absorbent tampons. Proctor & Gamble paid an undisclosed settlement to the victims and their families in these cases.

In Johnson v. Colt Industries Operating Corporation, Vic won a verdict of $2.25 million, including $1.25 million in punitive damages. In the courtroom, Vic proved the design of the Colt Single Action Revolver, which goes back to 1873 -- "The Gun That Won The West" -- was defective and unreasonably dangerous.

In Wolfgang v. Mid-America Motorsports, Inc., R.E.D. Racing, Inc. and World of Outlaws, Inc., Vic won a $1.2 million verdict for Hall of Fame Sprint Car driver Doug Wolfgang, against a race track and a sanctioning organization, for the failure to provide adequate fire and rescue services for drivers. Wolfgang had crashed during practice and was unconscious in his car. The rescue crew was poorly trained, equipped and prepared, and as a consequence he suffered burn injuries to his lower extremity. The case had major implications for the industry.

These are just a few victories in the legal life of Vic Bergman. He has many more. You may click the links to reports on many of Vic’s cases marked below.

attorneys.name: Erik A. Bergmanis Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Camdenton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Erik A. Bergmanis is the managing member of Bergmanis Law Firm, L.L.C. Mr. Bergmanis has been representing people at the Lake of the Ozarks for 40 years in both state and federal court in Missouri, and in other states in a wide variety of cases, including personal injury, wrongful death, products liability, criminal defense, social security disability, workers' compensation, commercial litigation, and various other areas of civil litigation.

Mr. Bergmanis was born and raised in Kirkwood, in the St. Louis, Missouri area. He graduated with honors from Drury College in Springfield, Missouri, in 1982, where he earned his Bachelor of Arts Degrees in Accounting and Business Administration. He was a member of Alpha Lambda Delta, Phi Delta Phi, and Kappa Alpha Order fraternities. After graduating from Drury College, Mr. Bergmanis attended the University of Missouri - Columbia School of Law, and received his Juris Doctorate in 1985.

Mr. Bergmanis became licensed to practice law by the Supreme Court of Missouri and the United States federal court in 1985. Immediately thereafter, he began his continuous years of service to the Missouri Bar and citizens of the State of Missouri by serving on the Missouri Bar Young Lawyer's Section Council from 1986 to 1995, and was the Chair Person of the Young Lawyer's Section Council from 1993 to 1994. Mr. Bergmanis has served on the Missouri Bar Foresight Committee, the Missouri Bar Professionalism Committee, and the Missouri Bar Complaint Resolution Program. He has been a member of the Missouri Bar Board of Governors since 1999, has served on the Board of Governors Executive Committee, and has been Chairman of the Missouri Bar Finance Committee from 2007-2013. He has been the Chair Person of the IOLTA Fund Task Force Committee, and served on the Special Committee relating to Tort Reform. He is the author of the Missouri Bar CLE Deskbook, "Boating While Intoxicated," and continues to serve on the Missouri Bar Legal Education Committee. Mr. Bergmanis has served as Municipal Judge for the City of Linn Creek for 22 years, with his service ending in 2016.

Mr. Bergmanis has served on the Advisory Board of ALTECCO, a Mission organization that serves the Amazon region in South America. He is a past board member of the Camdenton Chamber of Commerce, the Lake of the Ozarks West Chamber of Commerce, the Advisory Board of People's Bank, and is a former President of the Camden County Jaycees. He has also served in the past as a member of the Camdenton Rotary Club. Mr. Bergmanis has served over the past ten years in the capacity of coach for various Jefferson City hockey teams, including the Jefferson City High School Varsity Hockey Team 2008-2009 and 2010-2011.

Mr. Bergmanis makes his home at the Lake of the Ozarks with his wife, Alleta, and their two children, Cole and Lisa.

Our attorneys represent plaintiffs in personal injury and workers' compensation cases. We represent people charged with a crime in misdemeanor and felony cases. We provide aggressive representation for all of our clients with the goal of obtaining the best possible result in each case.

attorneys.name: Mark E. Berns
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Webster Groves, MO
attorneys.bio:
Mark Berns practices law in the areas of personal injury, products liability, mass tort, and class action litigation.

Mark was born and raised in St Louis. He graduated with a Bachelor of Arts in English literature from Knox College. Following his time at Knox, he obtained his law degree from Saint Louis University School of Law. He gained practical legal experience outside the classroom as a legal law clerk for The Honorable E. Richard Webber at the United States District Court, Eastern District of Missouri.

After law school, Mark joined a well-respected St. Louis law firm and focused his practice primarily on litigating personal injury claims on behalf of plaintiffs. He worked on a variety of serious injury and death cases, including products liability, motor vehicle accidents, trucking accidents, workplace accidents and workers’ compensation injuries.

Since joining OnderLaw, Mark focuses his practice on representing individuals in the areas of personal injury and products liability, including mass tort litigation on a national scale.

Mark is admitted to practice law in Missouri and the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri. He is active in the community; including his parish and his high school alumni board.

Mark lives in St. Louis with his wife, Taylor, and his two daughters.

attorneys.name: Richard B. Blanke
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Areas of Practice

Rick is first and foremost a civil litigator with over 35 years of experience, but his legal skills and accomplishments confirm a broader and deeper range of experience:

Business Litigation: Rick represents corporate entities, partners and partnerships, and individual clients in a wide range of business litigation matters such as contract disputes, corporate and partnership dissolutions, misappropriation and fraud cases, tortious interference, defamation, accounting disputes, non compete disputes, employment contracts, and employment discrimination matters (from representation in the EEOC and Missouri Commission on Human Rights to court trials and appeals).

Employer Protection: Rick has authored FMLA, discrimination and harassment compliance policies and response plans, and employment manuals, for major employers.

Real Estate Litigation: Rick has litigated scores of real estate disputes from the garden variety trespass, boundary dispute, and partition actions to complicated quiet title and commercial title and leasing disputes.

Family Law: Rick also has successfully handled many hundreds of divorces and domestic disputes, ranging from the simple non contested divorce to complicated property divisions and custody disputes. He has achieved impressive results in difficult support collection matters and enforcement (contempt) cases as well as in modifications of unreasonable prior decrees.

Personal Injury and Workers Compensation: Rick has experience in litigating and mediating personal injury cases including auto, truck, motorcycle, and pedestrian accidents, highway construction negligence, injuries from animals, products liability cases, and premises liability claims. Rick has successfully litigated numerous wrongful death cases and obtained large recoveries in aquatic cases such as diving injuries and drownings.

Civil Appeals: Rick is also an experienced and accomplished appellate lawyer. He has won numerous appeals and has an impressive winning record before the Missouri Supreme Court. Just a few of those cases are outlined below.

Whether litigating business, real estate, domestic, or injury disputes, civil litigation and appeals are Rick's forte. He knows how to negotiate from strength to save you (the client) thousands in litigation expenses and he also knows how to win tough courtroom battles. He is always available for an initial free phone consult and will timely respond to your e mail inquiries.

Awards and Honors

attorneys.name: Susan E. Block
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Susan Block returned to the practice of law after retiring as a Circuit Judge in 2004, with 25 years of judicial service. In her last judicial assignment she was appointed to serve as the Administrative Judge of the Family Court with the authority to manage the policies and practices of this division, while maintaining a full caseload of abuse, neglect, delinquency and adoption matters. Recipient of the Andrew Jackson Higgins Award for Excellence in Juvenile Justice, her work in the area of family law and child advocacy has been recognized locally and internationally.

Currently she focuses her practice in family law matters, including divorce, modifications, juvenile, guardianships, school law, juvenile law, adoptions, paternity matters, grandparents' visitation requests, and domestic partnership conflicts.

The unique combination of having been on both sides of the bench makes Judge Block an invaluable resource to her clients and her colleagues. Since becoming an active trial lawyer, she has quickly built a reputation as a compassionate and zealous advocate for her clients, taking on the most complex cases and thinking "out of the box" for creative solutions and impressive results.

Judge Block has received numerous local awards for her work in child advocacy, prevention of domestic violence, and innovative programming for the Family Court. They include the St. Louis Bar Foundation Award, Missouri Coalition for Domestic Violence-St. Louis Region Person of the Year Award, Public Citizen of the Year award given by the National Association of Social Workers Missouri Chapter, Metropolitan St. Louis YWCA Racial Justice Award, CASA Community Award, World of Children Award, National Council of Jewish Women-St. Louis Section Founder's Award and was honored by the Missouri Supreme Court for her outstanding service to the St. Louis County Circuit Court.

An innovator and visionary, she was a founding member of the Washington University Project for Children and Youth, 2002-2005, and served on the first Board of Directors for the National Truancy Prevention Association and Lawyers for Equality.

Well published, Judge Block authors the "Bench to Bar" monthly column for the St. Louis Lawyer magazine published by the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis. Recently, she co-authored "Grandparent Visitation Rights: History, Constitutionality, and Practice," in the April 2009 St. Louis Bar Journal. Following her presentation at the First International Conference on Domestic Violence in Rome, Italy, she wrote "Domestic Violence: A Problem Concealed. A Civil Response to Domestic Violence in the United States," California Western School of Law, Journal of Law, 1997. She has been a contributing writer for the St. Louis Post-Dispatch on Family Law Issues from 1997-2003, authoring "In Search of Safety Coordination Efforts."

Judge Block's teaching experience ranges from law school instruction to international forums. She has been an Adjunct Professor of Law at Washington University, St. Louis University and Emory University Schools of Law, specializing in pre-trial practice, trial practice, and trial technique courses. She has been sent abroad by the United States Department of State to instruct and advise countries on domestic violence laws and procedures, including the countries of Lithuania, the Czech Republic, Macedonia, and Russia. Locally she has given presentations on family law to the United States Arbitration and Mediation, Inc., the American Jewish Congress, and the Midwest School of Paralegal Studies. She was a veteran faculty member of the Missouri Judicial College and the National Judicial College. In addition, she provided private tutoring for law graduates preparing to take the Missouri Bar Examination in all areas of the law.

Paule, Camazine and Blumenthal is a full service Firm that benefits our family law clients by having attorneys in the Firm with particular expertise in business organizations, real estate, tax matters, corporations, immigration, intellectual property, civil litigation, and high net worth estate planning. This allows cost effective handling of complex and high net worth cases involving business valuations, business issues, real estate issues, trust and estate matters, and tax problems, unlike boutique-style Firms specializing only in family law.

Judge Block's community involvement ranges from having served on the boards of Food Outreach, Big Brothers and Big Sisters, Caring for Kids, the Missouri Children's Service Commission, the National Association of Women Judges and the St. Louis County Domestic Violence Council. Most recently, Governor Jay Nixon appointed her to serve on the board of the Missouri Children's Trust Fund, which seeks to prevent child abuse and educate the community on this important issue.

Judge Block is a graduate of Penn State University and the St. Louis University School of Law. She was also a participant in the John F Kennedy School of Government for Senior Executives in Local Government. She is the mother of four children and the grandmother of four. Her colleagues view her as a lawyer's lawyer and often seek out her advice in dealing with the Family Court.

"The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements."

attorneys.name: Charles W. Bobinette
attorneys.practice_type: Administrative Law Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
It is with heavy hearts that we inform you that Charles “Chuck” Whitney Bobinette, beloved husband, devoted friend, Attorney at Law and former St. Louis City Municipal Court Judge, passed away on Monday July 25, 2016.

With characteristic enthusiasm and tenacity, Chuck continued in his mission of serving his clients all the way through June 2016 when the effects of chemotherapy and the cancer itself became physically overpowering. At the end, he was surrounded by his wife Deborah, his loving family, coworkers and close friends.

Chuck was an extraordinary attorney who brought joy and insight to all who knew him.

Up until his last moments, Chuck was positive about life, and continued to display concern for family and friends, groups of which he considered his clients to be members. While ill, he staffed cases with other attorneys in the Firm to ensure his clients received the best representation possible.

Chuck was an inspiration to us all at Uthoff, Graeber, Bobinette & Blanke.

Chuck moved from his hometown of Chicago to attend Denison University in Ohio, then Saint Louis University School of Law, where he earned his Juris Doctor degree in 1971. Chuck first practiced as a managing attorney for the Legal Aid Society of St. Louis, a non-profit organization dedicated to providing free quality legal assistance to low-income families. It strives to strengthen families, build the community, and secure justice for disadvantaged clients. Since 1981 Chuck practiced as a partner at this Firm, where his civil trial and appellate practice focused on employment and business litigation, as well as in areas of personal injury and workers’ compensation. He utilized his legal expertise and passion for zealous representation to assist countless people in venues including both the Missouri Supreme Court and U.S. Supreme Court.

While practicing, Chuck served as an adjunct Professor at Saint Louis University School of Law and later as an Adjunct Professor and Judicial Clerkship leader at Washington University School of Law. His civic work included board service as Secretary of the City of St. Louis CASA. He was also dedicated to the Crusade Against Crime which awards its Medal of Valor in recognition of conspicuous acts of bravery exceeding the normal demands of police service. Chuck served as a Crusade’s board member for 28 years and as its president from 1998-2002.

Notwithstanding Chuck’s legal and civic successes, he will be best remembered as a treasured friend and family man. He was beloved most by his wife Deborah (nee Lord). Together the two shared 40 years of partnership as best friends.

We are committed to honoring Chuck’s legacy.

Chuck was a zealous advocate who worked tirelessly on his clients’ behalf. For his entire legal career, Chuck worked virtually 10 hours per day, and 6 or 7 days per week. He left no stone unturned when briefing or presenting his clients’ cases. All the time, Chuck was well regarded for his integrity, professionalism and candor with Judges, opposing counsel – and his clients. These characteristics coupled with his legal knowledge gained from education and decades of experience resulted in significant success for him and his clients.

Chuck will be sorely missed.

As our firm moves forward without Chuck, we pledge to deliver legal services of the highest standard and in the positive spirit exemplified by our friend and colleague, Charles Bobinette.

Sincerely,

Colleagues of the Firm of Uthoff, Graeber, Bobinette & Blanke

Chuck was a zealous advocate who worked tirelessly on his clients’ behalf. For his entire legal career, Chuck worked virtually 10 hours per day, and 6 or 7 days per week. He left no stone unturned when briefing or presenting his clients’ cases. All the time, Chuck was well regarded for his integrity, professionalism and candor with Judges, opposing counsel – and his clients. These characteristics coupled with his legal knowledge gained from education and decades of experience resulted in significant success for him and his clients.

Chuck will be sorely missed.

As our firm moves forward without Chuck, we pledge to deliver legal services of the highest standard and in the positive spirit exemplified by our friend and colleague, Charles Bobinette.

Sincerely,

Colleagues of the Firm of Uthoff, Graeber, Bobinette & Blanke

attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Baerveldt & Boedefeld, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Saint Charles, MO
attorneys.bio:
Christopher M. Boedefeld is licensed to practice law in the State of Missouri and the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri. Mr. Boedefeld received his undergraduate degree from Lindenwood University with an English major and Political Science minor after attending Missouri State University in Springfield, Missouri. He received his law degree from the University of Missouri - Kansas City School of Law.

Mr. Boedefeld practices primarily in the areas of Family (i.e. divorce, modifications, name change, paternity, adoptions, administrative child support hearings), Criminal (felonies and misdemeanors), Traffic Law (i.e. DWI, DWS, DWR, speeding tickets, etc.), Guardianships, Wills, Powers of Attorneys and civil litigation (CANRB hearings). Mr. Boedefeld offers a free half hour initial consultation and is available for client consultations during evenings and weekends upon request. His hourly rates are very competitive and he offers a flat fee on most legal matters with payment plan options on a case-by-case basis. Mr. Boedefeld has represented parties all over the State of Missouri from Jackson County (Kansas City) to Greene County (Springfield) to the metropolitan St. Louis area and the surrounding counties.

Mr. Boedefeld grew up in Lake St. Louis in St. Charles County and spent his youth playing soccer, football and wrestling. Mr. Boedefeld currently resides in Wentzville with his wife, Stacy and their five children. He has three daughters (Lauren, Natalie, Lillian) two sons (Nicholas and Landon) and three grandchildren. Mr. Boedefeld enjoys playing golf, snow skiing, screen-play writing and spending time with his family in his spare time.

He is a member of the Missouri Bar, the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis and the St. Charles County Bar Association. In addition, Mr. Boedefeld is a Missouri Notary Public. Mr. Boedefeld is an active member of Sigma Chi Fraternity - Eta Kappa chapter.

attorneys.name: Eric L. Boehmer
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in St. Charles, MO
attorneys.bio:
Eric Boehmer is an award winning attorney with the experience, confidence and knowledge to deal with the authorities when it comes to defending individuals against criminal charges. As a native of St. Charles County, Eric was born and raised in the Wentzville area. He attended St. Dominic High School in O'Fallon, MO. Eric was recently awarded a National Association of Distinguished Counsel Top 1% Award, a Top 100 Trial Attorney award for his achievements in Trial Law and a Top 10 Client Satisfaction Award for Criminal Law in Missouri.

Eric attended college at Furman University in South Carolina where he obtained his bachelor degree in Business Administration. While a player on Furman's baseball team, he was named to the all-conference tournament team and made the Dean's list for academic excellence. At Furman, Eric also became a member of the largest international fraternity, Tau Kappa Epsilon.

Upon graduation from Furman, Eric returned to the Show-Me State to attend law school at the University of Missouri-Columbia. He received the Cali Excellence for the Future Award before graduating with his Juris-Doctorate. Eric gained experience with internships at two different law firms and worked at the Attorney General's Office.

Upon passing the Missouri Bar Exam, Eric returned to St. Charles County to become an assistant prosecuting attorney. The trial experience and understanding of the court systems he gained during this time were building blocks that helped catapult his highly successful career as a criminal defense trial lawyer.

Eric's passion and expertise is operating in the courtroom and trying cases. He has tried numerous judge and jury trials with an extremely high success rate. He has multiple acquittals in Class A felony jury trials as well as many lower level felony and misdemeanors. Eric's proven track record and attention to detail in working for his clients has earned him the well-deserved reputation as a successful attorney. Please call now to make an appointment so that you can benefit from Eric's knowledge and experience.

attorneys.name: Jill S Bollwerk
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Law Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jill Bollwerk graduated in the top 5% of her class with a degree in Broadcast Communications from Southern Illinois University – Carbondale in 1987. She earned her law degree from St. Louis University School of Law in 1991.

Jill is admitted to practice before all Missouri and Illinois state courts, the Missouri Court of Appeals Eastern District, the United States District Courts for the Eastern District of Missouri and the Southern District of Illinois, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.

She began her career representing injured individuals in automobile and premises liability litigation, workers’ compensation matters, and Social Security Disability appeals for two prominent St. Louis plaintiff’s firms. She also spent a brief period working as a trial attorney for a major insurance company. After gaining significant trial experience, Jill established her own practice dedicated to representing injured individuals. Today, she continues that mission as the managing attorney of Bollwerk & Associates, LLC, where she devotes her career to fighting for the rights of accident victims and injured workers.

With more than three decades of experience, Jill has tried numerous jury and bench trials, handled workers’ compensation hearings and Social Security hearings, and argued appeals in both state and federal courts, as well as before the Missouri Labor & Industrial Relations Commission.

Her legal memberships include the Missouri Bar, the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis, the American Bar Association, the Illinois State Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, the Workers’ Injury Law & Advocacy Group, and the Lawyers Association of Metropolitan St. Louis. She has also volunteered her time with various programs sponsored by the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis. Jill has earned an AV Peer Review Rating from Martindale-Hubbell, the highest rating awarded by that organization.

A lifelong resident of St. Louis, Jill resides with her husband in South St. Louis County. She is the proud mother of two grown children and enjoys spending time with her grandchildren. Outside the courtroom, she has volunteered as a parish council member, scout leader, and youth sports coach, and she enjoys swimming, hiking, theatre, and music.

Attorney Mark Bolton has joined DM Injury Law in Kansas City to represent the wrongfully injured with a focus on workers’ compensation claims. With bar admissions in Kansas and Missouri, he is prepared to help our clients on both sides of the city.

Mark has long held onto the belief that the most rewarding work is the work that can help people in need. He brings his passion for doing what is right to each case he takes, taking the time to make sure each client feels heard, respected, and valued as their case progresses. When a difficult workers’ compensation case has put a client’s life on hold, Attorney Bolton is there to guide them through it with detail-oriented representation and frequent communication.

Growing up in the Overland Park area of Kansas City, Mark wanted to stay close to home when he finished his J.D. at Washburn University School of Law. As a member of DM Injury Law, he has the opportunity to empower the people of his own community each day through steadfast legal counsel.

Outside of the office, Mark is an automotive enthusiast and often works on and repairs cars and boats. He can often be found on boating trips to local lakes with his two playful dogs, Ranger and Jasper.

attorneys.name: Grant Boyd
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Grant C. Boyd is an attorney with the O’Brien Law Firm, located in St. Louis, Missouri. Mr. Boyd focuses his practice on representing victims of violent crime, sexual abuse victims, wrongful death claims, and other personal injury cases. Mr. Boyd has an established reputation of advocating aggressively and strongly on behalf of those who suffered an injury, survived abuse, or lost a loved one due to the negligent, careless or unlawful acts of others.

Mr. Boyd’s primary focus is lawsuits on behalf of sexual assault victims and crime victims. He has a documented history of achieving successful outcomes for victims, including large settlements for his clients. Mr. Boyd is a recipient of the 2018 Missouri Lawyers Media Top 10 Settlements Award. Apart from civil suits on behalf of victims, he also represents crime victims on a pro bono basis in criminal cases and in order-of-protection matters. His work on behalf of victims was recognized in 2020 when Missouri Lawyers honored Mr. Boyd with the 2020 Legal Champion Award.

Mr. Boyd received his Bachelor of Arts in legal studies and psychology from Saint Louis University in 2010. He then attended Saint Louis University School of Law, obtaining his Juris Doctorate in 2014. While pursuing his legal degree, Mr. Boyd was a selected to the Alpha Sigma Nu Honors Society. The recipient of several academic excellence awards, Mr. Boyd also received the Milton F. Napier Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy, and he was one of the leading members of the trial advocacy competition team.

After graduating law school, Mr. Boyd received his license to practice from The Missouri Bar in 2014. Apart from Missouri, Mr. Boyd is admitted to a number of United States District Courts across the country. Having clerked for Sindel Noble during his time as a law student, Mr. Boyd joined Sindel Noble upon graduation, and he has proved highly effective as a trial lawyer and legal advocate. In 2016, St. Louis Business Journal named him to its list of Top 30 Under 30 professionals in the region. He has been named a Super Lawyers Rising Star in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021.

Fully committed to his practice, Mr. Boyd is a member of The Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis, as well as the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, and National Crime Victim Bar Association. He is currently a council member on the Young Lawyers Council of the National Crime Victim Bar Association.

An avid hockey player, Mr. Boyd is active in youth hockey programs throughout his community and assists families in taking part in the sport. Mr. Boyd is also involved with supporting inner-city schools, including The BIOME School.

attorneys.name: Douglas R. Bradley
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury & Wrongful Death Lawyers in Lexington, MO
attorneys.bio:
Doug joined the Bradley & Bradley L.C. law firm in 2015 after practicing for over eight years at a boutique Kansas City law firm specializing in complex litigation and personal injury trial work. Born and raised in Lexington, Missouri, he is a third-generation attorney who brings small-town values and a tireless work ethic to his practice. From an early age, Doug learned to respect and admire the responsibility and personal reward that comes from being an attorney, having watched his father, Gary Bradley, and grandfather, Newton Bradley, help clients obtain justice through the legal system.

Doug is licensed to practice in the states of Missouri and Kansas. His practice focuses on personal injury and wrongful death cases involving automotive and trucking accident litigation, product liability and automotive defects, recreational injuries, spinal cord and traumatic brain injuries, bad faith insurance litigation and general tort law. Doug’s practice also includes workers compensation, estate planning (wills & trusts) and estate litigation, real estate, corporation formation and representation, and traffic and criminal defense. Doug was named as one of the “Best of the Bar” by the Kansas City Business Journal. He was also recognized as one of the “Top 40 under 40” lawyers by the National Trial Lawyers, Top 10 Under 40 Award for Missouri by NAOPIA, and as a Super Lawyer’s “Rising Star” in Missouri and Kansas by SuperLawyer’s Magazine. Doug is also a member of the Million Dollar and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

Doug attended law school at the University of Missouri-Kansas City where he graduated in the top ten percent of his class in May 2006. While at law school, Doug was a member of the Law Review, treasurer for the Student Bar Association and a teaching assistant for the law school’s Academic Enrichment Program. Prior to attending law school, Doug graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Missouri-Columbia, earning a degree in Business Administration with an emphasis in Finance in May 2003.

Doug’s hobbies include traveling, playing golf and skiing. Most of all Doug looks forward to spending time with his wife Anne, who is also a lawyer, and their two children

attorneys.name: Gary R. Bradley
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Lexington, MO
attorneys.bio:
We handle all of our cases on a personal and professional basis using our experience for your benefit. I have a personal commitment to my clients to operate under the golden rule and treat you as I would like to be treated. A lawsuit is a temporary relationship where I have certain professional responsibilities and you have certain personal responsibilities. We will communicate and work together to make critical professional and personal decisions at each step of the trial preparation process.

In addition to the legal training and legal preparation we must use in handling your case, I have a genuine affection for people. I enjoy meeting new people and assisting them through the stages of litigation. I believe in both being an attorney and counselor. Being a counselor sometimes helps the client through some of the personal and emotional portions of the loss of a dear family member, coming to terms with a permanent and severe injury, and coping with the numerous surgeries and physical therapy to regain less than total use of a portion of the body. Following an untimely death of a family member, trust and estate litigation involves obtaining cooperation from various competing family or financial interests. The emotional loss of a loved one together with an unexpected financial loss requires professional competence to gain the appropriate legal inheritance and recovery.

attorneys.name: Jim Brady
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas Ctiy, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jim Brady has been practicing law for 10 years in Missouri courts. In addition to providing clients personal service and strong advocacy, Jim is a Kansas City native, former Marine and father of two. He is also on the board of the Blue River Watershed Association.

After receiving his bachelor’s from Loyola University, Jim earned his law degree from John Marshall Law School in Chicago. After graduation, Jim opened his own practice dedicated to personal injury and criminal defense. It was during this time that he found his talent for trial advocacy.

Jim’s first trial was against Pettis County, MO for the wrongful death of a woman who drowned when her car slid off a dangerous county bridge with no guardrails. Several attorneys had passed on the case because the victim had been drinking. However, Jim won a $750,000 verdict for the woman’s family.

Jim’s zeal for helping those in need combined with his high level experience make him an exceptional addition to our firm.

attorneys.name: Dr. Brad Bradshaw
attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Injury Lawyers in Webster Groves, MO
attorneys.bio:
Dr. Brad Bradshaw stands out among catastrophic injury attorneys, with over 30 years of experience consolidating medicine and law. As a licensed physician, surgeon, and lawyer, he’s no stranger to the legal intricacies of representing clients with traumatic injuries and damages. Just as importantly, his experience with catastrophic injury lawsuits has created a passion for advocating for people who have experienced the most challenging circumstances – wrongful death, personal injury, or medical malpractice.

Dr. Bradshaw is committed to helping people harmed by dangerous or negligent acts committed by corporations, individuals, and other responsible parties. He is a physician dedicated to helping injured people rebuild their lives by obtaining quality medical care and financial compensation. He uses his skills as a physician and trial lawyer to help people recover compensation for past and future medical care, loss of life’s enjoyments, loss of earning capacity, and lost wages, in addition to seeking justice for those who have died.

Dr. Bradshaw is a respected member of the legal community and has held leadership positions in several professional organizations. His skills as a litigator have resulted in significant victories on behalf of his clients. However, his experience goes beyond courtrooms and boardrooms. Dr. Bradshaw is also a notable author and lecturer, sharing his expertise on the intricate crossroads of medicine and law as a leader in both fields.

Dr. Brad Bradshaw is a graduate of the University of Missouri, Kansas City School of Law, and has been practicing law for over 25 years. He is also a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum. He has recovered millions of dollars in verdicts and settlements on behalf of plaintiffs.

Dr. Bradshaw is a skilled trial lawyer who is fearless in fighting for the rights of injured people. He is also a compassionate advocate who understands the physical, emotional, and financial challenges that seriously injured people face. He is licensed to practice medicine in Missouri and Hawaii. He is licensed to practice law in Missouri, Kansas, Texas, Hawaii, the District of Columbia, Iowa, and Washington.

attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Fulton, MO
attorneys.bio:
As a lifelong Mid-Missourian, Jacque Brazas understands the balance of tradition and innovation that defines life and business in this region. She helps her clients navigate life’s transitions with clarity and confidence — whether developing an estate plan, resolving complex family matters, or guiding real estate and business transactions.

Rooted in trust and guided by progress, Jacque brings creativity and strategic insight to every case. Her approach blends thoughtful counsel with the modern tools and technology that make communication clear and service efficient. She takes pride in helping clients feel seen, heard, and supported while delivering practical, forward-looking legal solutions.

A skilled advocate in and out of the courtroom, Jacque has achieved successful outcomes for clients in hearings and trials across a range of practice areas, including real estate, domestic relations, and construction disputes. Her dedication and results have earned her recognition on the Missouri & Kansas Rising Stars list each year since 2019. Part of the Super Lawyers validation program, Jacque's selection to the Rising Stars list bestows an honor that is limited to no more than 2.5% of attorneys within Missouri. Super Lawyers recognizes attorneys who have distinguished themselves in their legal practice.

Jacque began her legal career with Riley Brazas PC’s predecessor firm and joined Tom Riley as a shareholder in 2021. She continues a long-standing tradition of trusted representation in Callaway, Boone, and surrounding counties — helping individuals, families, and businesses protect what they’ve built and plan for what’s next.

When she’s not practicing law, Jacque enjoys time with her husband, Shawn, and their two sons, Luke and Beau. She’s an avid reader and runner who often travels with friends and family to participate in races around the country.

attorneys.name: Kenneth John Brennan
attorneys.practice_type: Mass Torts Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Since 2009, Kenneth Brennan has been a valuable asset to our team of attorneys at TorHoerman Law.

Ken Brennan is an accomplished trial lawyer with over 20 years of experience in courtrooms throughout the United States.

Professional Career

Upon graduation from the University of Iowa College of Law, Ken began his career at a defense firm in St. Louis, Missouri.

After six years of defending large corporations against “the little guy”, Ken determined he wanted to help those same individuals he was once opposing.

That decision resulted in a passion for helping those injured through no fault of their own, and 20+ years later, Ken has become a highly-skilled, distinguished Plaintiffs lawyer.

Ken’s extensive experience on both sides of the courtroom has given him a broad range of practical knowledge and understanding required to address the complex technical and legal issues that arise in mass tort litigations.

Ken is proud to have taken on some of the largest industries in the world – including the pharmaceutical, communications, auto, banking, and insurance industries.

In 2017, Ken obtained an important personal jurisdiction decision from the Illinois Appellate Court.

In another notable case, the court praised Ken for his efforts to overturn an ERISA Plan’s decades-long misinterpretation of its disability pension requirements.

According to the order, “the public interest has been significantly advanced by the counsel’s efforts.”

Prior to concentrating on mass tort cases, Ken had a successful career representing individual consumers, small businesses, multinational corporations, franchisors, and franchisees.

Notable Cases & Results

Ken Brennan is an accomplished trial lawyer with over 20 years of experience in courtrooms throughout the United States.

After six years of defending large corporations against “the little guy”, Ken determined he wanted to help those same individuals he was once opposing.

That decision resulted in a passion for helping those injured through no fault of their own, and 20+ years later, Ken has become a highly-skilled, distinguished Plaintiffs lawyer.

Ken’s extensive experience on both sides of the courtroom has given him a broad range of practical knowledge and understanding required to address the complex technical and legal issues that arise in mass tort litigations.

attorneys.name: Dakota Britt Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Going through a divorce or family law matter can be an emotional time that can leave you feeling betrayed, lost, or overwhelmed. Having an attorney that can relate to you, and who focuses on divorce and family law can make the process easier. Dakota Britt is a compassionate Team Leader Attorney with Stange Law Firm, PC who can represent clients throughout Kansas City and the surrounding areas from the firm's Kansas City, MO office location.

Dakota completed his undergraduate degree at Graceland University, earning a Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice while minoring in Business, English, and Human Services. While there, he was a captain and member of the Graceland wrestling team and earned the Freeman Student-Athlete Award, which is given to the senior varsity athlete with the highest cumulative GPA on each varsity team. He was also Vice President of the Student Senate and Board Member of the Student Athlete Advisory Committee. Dakota earned his Juris Doctorate at the University of Arkansas-Little Rock School of Law. During his time there, he was a full time representative of the Student Bar Association for multiple years and was a member of the Barrister's Ball Committee. He is currently licensed to practice in the State of Missouri.

Prior to joining Stange Law Firm, Dakota participated in the Bowen School of Law Litigation Clinic getting valuable experience in family law. He drafted a wide variety of documents relating to domestic relations and guardianship matters, as well as a variety of correspondences including legal memorandums, closing memorandums, and status updates of pending cases. He worked closely with clients who were going through divorce and family law matters. He then moved on to work as a Law Clerk at a firm in Little Rock, Arkansas that worked on numerous cases relating to domestic relations, contracts, personal injury, property, probate, and criminal law. While there he assisted in depositions, client meetings, and trial preparations.

While not assisting clients, Dakota enjoys participating in a variety of different sports. He currently competes in power lifting and also enjoys hiking.

attorneys.name: Bryan Brody
attorneys.practice_type: Consumer Law Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Bryan Brody has been recognized as an "experienced litigator of consumer protection cases in Missouri" by the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri.

Since 2007, when he led the Missouri office of a national lemon law firm, Bryan has handled over 1,000 consumer cases. As a result, Bryan is familiar with the business practices of every major vehicle manufacturer in the United States as well as many Missouri car dealerships. He has also brought and/or tried cases under almost every consumer protection statute, including the Missouri Merchandising Practices Act (MMPA), Magnuson–Moss Warranty Act (MMWA), Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), Truth in Lending Act, (TILA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Electronic Funds Transfer Act (EFTA), Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), Federal Odometer Act (FOA), and the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA).

Bryan Brody founded Brody & Cornwell in 2016, where he has continued to focus his practice on consumer law. He is a member of the National Association of Consumer Attorneys and the Missouri Association of Consumer Attorneys.

Bryan was born and raised in St. Louis, and attended Washington University in St. Louis, where he double-majored in earth & planetary science and history. He then went to Tulane Law School in New Orleans, Louisiana, where he was the only student in his class to be on a journal, moot court, and a law clinic at the same time. Besides his law practice, Bryan enjoys the St. Louis Cardinals and St. Louis Blues and playing tennis and racquetball and spending time with his family.

She also mentors in three fields of immigration practice for AILA, and her law offices currently serve as a clinic site for Washington University School of Law, Civil Rights and Community Justice Clinic.

attorneys.name: Richard T. Bryant
attorneys.practice_type: Hotel, restaurant , liquor and bar licensing Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
I was affiliated from my admission to the Missouri Bar until December 1, 1995 with the general practice law firm of Copilevitz, Bryant & Schmid, P.C. This firm was originally known as Harding & Copilevitz, P.C. and thereafter known as Copilevitz, Bryant, Gray & Jennings, P.C. Because of the departure of two partners from active practice in the firm, the firm was renamed.

From December 1, 1995 until the present, I have been affiliated with Richard T. Bryant & Associates, P.C. (formerly Bryant & Picerno, P.C.). This firm continues to be a general practice firm with specialties in Constitutional law, insurance investigation and defense, domestic relations, municipal and land use law.

I have engaged in the preparation and trial of the Circuit Court cases in all areas of the law, including family law and domestic relations, insurance, and Constitutional law, and also Associate Circuit Division cases and Municipal Court cases. I have also prepared and presented cases in administrative matters on local and state levels. I have experience in criminal and juvenile cases.

Practice before the Circuit of Jackson County, Missouri includes both bench and jury-tried cases, both as lead counsel and as a secondary counsel. I am familiar with applicable rules of court governing civil procedure in the U.S. District Courts for both the Western and Eastern Districts of Missouri, as well as rules promulgated by the Jackson County Circuit Court and various other Missouri Circuit Court divisions, the Kansas Supreme Court and a number of municipalities and administrative boards.

I have served as the Administrative Hearing Officer of the Housing Authority of Kansas City, Missouri since November 14, 1988. I conduct and hear cases concerning issues involving tenant selection and termination of tenancy, and I also conduct hearings with respect to cases involving interpretation of lease provisions for all persons involved in Section 8 and Public Housing cases. Further, I was selected by the position of the Judge of the Municipal Court of Kansas City, Missouri.

From May 15, 1976, until my enrollment with the Missouri Bar, I was affiliated with the Lenexa, Kansas Police Department as a police legal advisor intern. My primary areas of responsibility included training police officers as assisting in the preparation and prosecution of municipal ordinance cases under the supervision of the City Prosecutor. I provided similar service to the City of Westwood, Kansas and its police department between January 15, 1977, and September 3, 1978 under the supervision of the City Prosecutor. During that time I was also responsible for codifying, revising, and drafting city ordinances relating to public offenses and training police personnel in arrest procedures and matters of legal interest. As you may know, the City of Kansas City, Missouri recently codified and revised its city ordinances, much in the same fashion that I did for the City of Westwood, Kansas.

Between January 1978 and June 1982, I served with the Investigations Division of the Lenexa, Kansas Police Department, assisting in legal aspects of major cases and in Internal Affairs Investigations.

From May 15, 1976, until September 3, 1978, I was employed with the law firm Stoup & Thompson, engaging in legal research, investigation and case preparation. From April 1, 1978 until admission to the Missouri Bar, I was also affiliated with the firm of Harding & Copilevitz, P.C., as a law clerk.

attorneys.name: Michael Edward Bub
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Michael Bub is an experienced trial attorney who has represented insurance companies and their insureds for more than twenty years in hundreds of cases across Missouri and Illinois. He has successfully defended product manufacturers and retailers in dozens of serious injury cases involving allegedly defective products including automobiles, tires, hand tools, industrial machinery, ambulance cots, swimming pools, bicycling equipment, and numerous other products. Mr. Bub has also defended transportation companies, including trucking, motor coach and student transportation companies. He has successfully argued cases before the Missouri Court of Appeals, United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, and the Illinois Appellate Court, Fifth District.

Mr. Bub has achieved Martindale-Hubbell's AV rating, its highest rating for attorneys. He was also named to the 2005, 2006, 2007 and 2008 editions of the Missouri-Kansas Super Lawyers in Civil Litigation. In January 2007, Mr. Bub successfully defended General Motors in a post-collision vehicle fire case in the City of St. Louis, Kline v. GM, which was named as number three in the Missouri Lawyers Weekly Top Defense Verdicts of 2007.

Mr. Bub is a member of the Defense Research Institute, and the Missouri Organization of Defense Lawyers for whom he previously served as a member of the Board of Directors.

attorneys.name: Thomas M. Burke
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Webster Groves, MO
attorneys.bio:
Thomas M. Burke is an accomplished attorney with a wealth of experience in various legal settings. Mr. Burke has joined OnderLaw as part of our affiliation with Hullverson Law Firm, a prestigious St. Louis firm with more than 100 years of experience. He has successfully handled a wide range of civil cases, including personal injury, products liability, medical malpractice, premises liability, and workers’ compensation. He is also well-versed in handling appeals.

In addition to his impressive legal career, Mr. Burke has held prestigious leadership positions within the legal community. He served as the president of both the Missouri Bar (2008 to 2009) and Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis (1996 to 1997). Hee was elected by the lawyers of the Eastern District of Missouri to serve a 6 year term (2012-2017) as their representative on the Missouri Appellate Judicial Commission, which is responsible for nominating Judges to Missouri’s Appellate and Supreme Courts.

As further testament to his commitment to the profession, he served as a trustee of the Missouri Bar from 2014 to 2017. He has been actively involved in organizations such as the Missouri Bar Foundation, the St. Louis Bar Foundation, and the Missouri Lawyer Trust Account Foundation (IOLTA). Mr. Burke’s dedication to the legal field extends to his service as a lawyer representative on various panels and committees, including the Office of Chief Disciplinary Counsel’s Disciplinary Panel.

Mr. Burke’s reputation as a knowledgeable legal professional has earned him numerous accolades. He is listed in Best Lawyers of America and Who’s Who in American Law. He has maintained an AV rating in Martindale Hubbell since 1986, reflecting his exceptional skills and ethical standards. Recognized for his contributions to the legal community, Mr. Burke received the Award of Merit from the Missouri Bar in 2009 and the Distinguished Lawyer Award from the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis in 2007.

With his extensive experience, Mr. Burke has been a sought-after presenter and contributor at continuing legal education (CLE) programs and civic education initiatives. He has actively participated in committees such as the Civil Practice and Procedure Committee, Solo and Small Firm Practice Committee, Tort Law Committee, and Workers’ Compensation Committee of the Missouri Bar. Mr. Burke’s dedication to staying current with legal developments and sharing his knowledge has made him a respected figure in the legal profession.

At OnderLaw, Mr. Burke’s expertise and commitment to justice make him a valuable asset to our team. His exceptional track record, deep involvement in legal associations, and recognition by esteemed publications underscore his dedication to providing outstanding legal representation to our clients.
