attorneys.bio:
Jeff Burns is one of the preeminent truck crash attorneys in the country. Over the span of his career he has not only tirelessly fought for justice for his clients, but more importantly, has worked on a national level to reform and change the trucking industry to be safer.

He has spent almost as much time in Washington D.C. as Kansas City educating the public and working for rule changes, stronger laws and stricter enforcement.

Jeff’s goal is to help trucking companies realize there is a return on investment when they institute or strengthen safety programs. There is less litigation, and drivers stay with companies longer when they see stronger safety rules as a genuine commitment to help protect them.

attorneys.name: J.J. Burns
attorneys.practice_type: Truck Accidents Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
J.J. Burns has a national reputation as a go-to-expert on truck crash litigation. Through both jury verdicts and negotiated settlements, he helps truck crash victims and their families hold truck drivers, motor carries and freight brokers accountable for their negligence. Additionally, he works continuously to introduce safer practices and more demanding safety rules in numerous states and across the country.

He is currently the Editor of the Journal of Trucking Litigation, and has also served on the Amicus Brief and Education Committee of the American Association for Justice’s Trucking Litigation Group after being appointed to TLG’s Executive Board. JJ regularly teaches other attorneys how to try cases against trucking companies, and has presented at seminars, conferences, and litigation colleges in Arizona, California, Kentucky, Louisiana, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas and Wyoming. JJ is also an adjunct professor at UMC Law School and teaches a course on injury litigation every year.

JJ is devoted to making our highways safer. He spends substantial time in Washington D.C. advocating for the passage of laws and regulations that will improve safety on public roadways, and help to ensure that fewer families have to suffer losses due to preventable crashes.

attorneys.name: Hyemin Byun
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
As lead of the workers’ compensation department, Hyemin Byun works tirelessly to get the very best results for her clients at DM Injury Law. She never rests when it comes to protecting her clients’ rights.

Hyemin began her career as a public defender, advocating for those who could not afford legal representation. During this time, she gained invaluable courtroom experience and learned how to approach cases with great compassion. She finds it extremely rewarding to help those who would otherwise go unheard or forgotten.

At DM Injury Law, Hyemin takes the time to listen to her clients’ concerns so that she can address them early on. She is thorough in compiling workers’ comp claims, which only serves to increase her chances of success. She also takes care to explain the law and process in comprehensive yet understandable terms to every single client.

Hyemin grew up in Junction City, Kansas. She is the daughter of two immigrants and has a sister in the Army National Guard. Her family works closely with the military, as well. Thus, she has a genuine appreciation for our nation’s service members. She earned her B.A. in applied behavioral sciences, with a minor in business, at the University of Kansas before finding her true calling at the Washburn University School of Law.

Outside the office, Hyemin loves spending time with her friends and going to new restaurants or to live concerts in the Kansas City metro area. She also likes to attend sporting events, especially to cheer on the Chiefs. On the weekend, you may find her hiking outside and enjoying the weather.

attorneys.name: Justin L. Cardwell
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Hillsboro, MO
attorneys.bio:
Justin Cardwell, a partner since 2021, grew up in Holts Summit, Missouri and graduated from Helias High School in Jefferson City. After high school, Justin attended Truman State University on a full academic scholarship where he received a B.S. in Psychology with a minor in Statistical Methods. Justin remained at Truman State University to pursue a Master of Science degree in Biology, focusing his research on the effect of methamphetamine on serotonin receptors in rats, and he completed his degree in the spring of 2010. Justin began law school at the Saint Louis University School of Law in the fall of 2008 and attained his J.D. in May of 2011, while also earning a Certificate in Health Law.

Upon graduation from law school, Justin was admitted to the Missouri Bar in September of 2011 and began practice at South County Senior Law & Estate Planning Center in May of 2012 where he focused on general estate planning, Medicaid planning, and VA planning. After two years, Justin moved into the health law field working for SSM Health Care in the transactions division of their in-house legal department.

He is a past Vice President of the Board of Directors for Green Wish St. Louis, a nonprofit organization focused on supporting green projects in the St. Louis metropolitan area.

Justin lives in Imperial with his wife and son.

attorneys.bio:
Patrick Carney is an attorney who is not afraid of fighting insurance companies on behalf of his clients. Initially drawn to the law through his interest in environmental advocacy, he ultimately found his calling in personal injury law, where he could fight for individuals who might otherwise be powerless against large corporations.

Before joining the firm, Patrick worked as a title insurance claims attorney. There, he witnessed firsthand how insurance companies could leave people vulnerable, even causing homeowners to lose everything due to errors beyond their control.

Patrick takes a deliberate approach to his cases, leveraging his insider knowledge of insurance company tactics to protect his clients from the same pitfalls he once saw others fall into. He prides himself on being approachable and compassionate, understanding that this overwhelming experience can be some of the scariest moments in a person’s life.

Originally from Chesterfield, Missouri, Patrick earned both his undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Missouri. A passionate Mizzou football and Cardinals baseball fan, he also enjoys hiking, skiing, playing soccer, and playing blues guitar—especially inspired by his favorite musician, Robert Johnson.

attorneys.name: Kevin M. Carnie Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Product Liability Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Kevin Carnie Jr. has earned a reputation for taking on some of the most high-profile cases in the region, securing nearly half a billion dollars in verdicts and settlements for his clients.

Carnie focuses on catastrophic personal injury and product liability cases. His product liability cases range from accidents involving cranes, vehicles, construction equipment, heavy machinery, factory equipment, and medical devices. His personal injury practice includes medical malpractice, auto accidents, trucking accidents, and civil rights cases.

Kevin’s business litigation experience includes antitrust claims, insurance coverage issues, securities fraud, real estate, consumer fraud, class action, banking litigation, patent infringement, and contract disputes.

Some of his most notable cases include a $109 million verdict on behalf of an asphalt company. In that case, Carnie proved a quarry company misrepresented the quality and gradation of its base rock that led to failures at two surface parking lots. The jury awarded the exact amount Carnie’s client lost in profits and the cost of redoing the parking lots as well as awarded more than $108 million in punitive damages.

He also represented a 17-year-old Tennessee girl who lost both of her legs when she was struck by a speeding and impaired driver who ran a yield sign. Kevin obtained a settlement close to the maximum amount state law allows against government entities, based on the government’s failure to place a stop sign at the intersection.

His class action work has included a $32.4 million jury verdict in a Telephone Consumer Protection Act case involving robocalls.

In an eight-figure class action settlement for Illinois doctors, Kevin’s work forced insurance companies to pay doctors interest on late payments.

His product liability experience includes a $24 million settlement for a man who suffered catastrophic injuries during an industrial equipment accident. The case brought awareness to inadequate safety guards on industrial machinery.

He’s also been a fierce advocate for children with disabilities, winning a $20 million settlement after uncovering abusive conditions on their school buses.

Kevin also won a $3.1 million verdict for a murder victim’s family, highlighting the need for reform at a problem property in St. Louis.

Kevin’s work has also exposed the dangerous practice of overprescription of amphetamines. He represented a mother who brought her daughter to a rehab facility, where she was prescribed Vyvanse and eventually suffered a fatal stroke due to overprescription. Kevin secured a $5 million jury verdict in that case.

He represented a police officer who was paralyzed during a shooting after the officer’s bullet proof vest failed to protect him. The trial brought attention to the limitations of body armor, helping to save law enforcement lives.

Kevin also isn’t afraid to hold law enforcement accountable. In addition to his significant trial expertise, he has extensive experience in civil rights matters. He’s frequently quoted and featured in the media as a subject matter expert on the topic, including The Pulitzer Center, The Marshall Project as well as St. Louis Public Radio and TV news affiliates.

He represented a man who died while being held in a prone restraint position for too long, causing a fatal medical emergency. The case went all the way to the United States Supreme Court, helping shape reform in policing tactics. Due, in part, to his work on that case, the police department adopted changes to its review of police misconduct and reassessed its legal policy for defending civil rights cases.

He also won a $1.25 million verdict for a man after an officer illegally entered his home and used a Taser to subdue him for a parking ticket.

Carnie graduated summa cum laude from Saint Louis University, where he double majored in psychology and criminal justice. He obtained his law degree from Saint Louis University, where he served as an editor of the Saint Louis University Public Law Review. He graduated cum laude and within the top 5% of his class, earning him induction to the Order of the Woolsack.

He lives with his wife and two daughters in St. Louis.

attorneys.name: Kevin Carr
attorneys.practice_type: Motor Vehicle Collisions Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Kevin Carr is an experienced Trial Attorney at DM Injury Law who represents victims and families in matters involving motor vehicle collisions, premises accidents, and serious personal injury.

While Kevin has a background in public service, his passion for the law has personal roots. His mother was severely injured by a defective product and faced many legal challenges when the companies involved attempted to deny liability. Fortunately, his mother had good legal representation and was able to obtain rightful compensation and justice for her damages. This experience taught him about the importance of having a good lawyer and shaped his desire to help others who find themselves facing off against powerful corporations that put profits over people and do everything they can to pay victims as little as possible.

A Missouri native who grew up in Lee’s Summit, Kevin attended the University of Missouri for both his undergraduate degree in political science and philosophy and his Juris Doctor. While in law school, he served as Managing Editor of the school’s Journal of Dispute Resolution, President of the Federalist Society, and participated in Mizzou’s Veterans Clinic helping veterans obtain needed benefits. He also worked in the general counsel’s office of the Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations.

Prior to becoming an attorney, Kevin worked on high-level political campaigns and in the Missouri Governor’s Office, where he assisted thousands of Missourians in accessing state services and solving their problems before the state’s administrative agencies. It was in this capacity that he gained invaluable experience helping people who were navigating difficult and unexpected events, and refined his approach of being a calm and compassionate advocate that people can trust to solve their issues.

As a Plaintiffs’ Lawyer with DM Injury Law, Kevin draws from his expansive background and his own personal experiences to help clients fight for the justice they deserve. He is known for his extraordinarily close attention to detail, personalized approach, and for providing the passionate support victims and families need to navigate their claims. This includes devoting the necessary time to helping clients understand their legal rights, making himself readily available, and developing the detailed strategies that position them for the maximum financial recovery possible.

Outside of the courtroom, Kevin enjoys spending time with his dad and uncle hunting for hidden treasures at estate and garage sales, tooling around town, cooking new recipes, and catching up on favorite shows with his wife and cat.

attorneys.name: Douglas L. Carter
attorneys.practice_type: Plaintiffs Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Trial attorney Doug Carter originally hails from Willow Springs, a small town in south central Missouri. When his father, a Missouri State Highway Patrolman, was killed in 1969, he moved with his mother to Springfield, Missouri. Already a budding advocate, he led his high school debate team to many statewide victories. At the University of Missouri/Columbia, he won the only college debate tournament he entered and was elected Student Government President for the largest academic division on campus.

Destined to become a distinguished trial lawyer, Doug graduated in 1981 from Duke University School of Law where he edited the Duke Law Journal and competed on the school's National Moot Court Team - for which fewer than 1% of law students qualify. He then went to Washington, D.C. and began his career as a trial lawyer.

Doug returned to the Midwest in 1985 and became a shareholder in two large Kansas City law firms. He defended major propane companies in serious burn, brain damage and death cases from coast to coast but sensed that something was wrong. Founding his own firm in 1996, Doug now has a strong record of making a difference in the lives of injury victims by delivering aggressive, focused experience with compassion and a commitment to justice.

Contact him today at 816-283-3500 for a free initial consultation.

attorneys.name: Kevin D. Case
attorneys.practice_type: Trial Practice Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Kevin Case has spent more than 30 years prosecuting and defending the interests of local government, licensed professionals, and diverse members of the local, regional, national and international business community: retail, agriculture, construction, manufacturing, insurance and transportation.

As his practice grew, he recognized the need for a Firm with like-minded attorneys. In 2001, he founded the Firm that is now Case Linden. In 2020, Mr. Case stepped down as Managing Partner of the Firm to return full-time to the courtroom.

In Kansas, his trial record includes significant victories from all corners of the State and in each of its federal courthouses located in Kansas City, Topeka and Wichita.

In Missouri, he has recorded jury trial wins in the courthouses in Columbia, Hillsboro, Independence, Kansas City, Liberty, Springfield, and both the City and County of St. Louis.

Mr. Case's litigation record includes the successful defense of hundreds of employers in a myriad of employment claims under state and federal anti-discrimination and retaliation statutes such as the Missouri Human Rights Act, the ADA, ADEA, FMLA and Title VII.

He has defended numerous catastrophic claims involving wrongful death and traumatic brain injuries arising from industrial accidents, defective products and a variety of other transportation accidents.

He has represented professionals in various claims of malpractice including those in the medical profession and his peers in the legal profession.

Mr. Case's public service extends beyond the Firm. He was appointed assistant attorney general by two different attorneys general. He served in an elected office in municipal government, as a member and chairman of a planning and zoning commission, and as a judge to resolve disputes arising from a Kansas City-area public housing authority. Two mayors appointed him to serve as board trustee for one of the largest acute care hospitals in the Kansas City metropolitan area that employed more than 3,000 employees where he served on board committees with oversight of professional management and litigation.

Mr. Case is married and resides in Kansas City.

attorneys.bio:
Dominic Cicerelli was raised in St. Charles, MO and graduated from Francis Howell High School in 2008. He achieved his bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice from Southeast Missouri State University in 2012, where he graduated with cum laude honors, and served as president of the Pi Kappa Alpha Fraternity and Criminal Justice Association. In 2016, Mr. Cicerelli graduated from the University of Missouri School of Law and was admitted to practice law in Missouri.

Despite being recently admitted to the practice of law, Mr. Cicerelli has already provided excellent legal representation to several clients. For instance, one client was arrested for felony stealing and was charged as a prior and persistent offender. A bank surveillance video showed the client picking up an iPhone that did not belong to him and exiting the bank. After a two-day jury trial, Mr. Cicerelli's client was found not guilty. Mr. Cicerelli has also filed several appellate briefs before the Missouri Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court of Missouri.

Mr. Cicerelli focuses his practice on criminal defense and personal injury. He takes great pride in achieving favorable outcomes for his clients, and is constantly focused on developing his skill set and increasing his knowledge of the law.

attorneys.name: Carl J. Civella
attorneys.practice_type: DWI & Drug Defense Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
I was born and raised in St. Louis, Missouri. Attended St. Louis Priory high school in Creve Coeur, Missouri before moving onto college at St. Louis University. I graduated Magna Cum Laude with a degree from St. Louis University in Finance in 1988.

After taking a year off to explore an occupation in the Finance field, I decided to listen to the advice from my grandfather and seek my lifelong passion of becoming a lawyer. I graduated St. Louis University School of Law in 1993. I immediately obtained a license to practice in both Missouri and Illinois. Due to my experience with criminal defense during my summers in law school, I decided to open my own criminal defense practice with a focus on DWI and Drug Offenses in 1994.

In 2007, I became a municipal prosecutor, which gave me a unique advantage in the courtroom when defending criminal cases. I was better able to see a criminal case from both sides. Additionally, I have regularly attended DWI seminars nationwide, giving me the latest strategies in DWI defense, and up-to- date knowledge of breath instrument technology

I've been happily married for 22 years and have two boys, ages 18 and 21. I was very involved with them growing up, teaching them the importance of family, faith and an education. I thoroughly enjoyed acting as their baseball coach for many of those years.

I have continued my sole practice in Clayton now for 28 years, still passionate and loving what I do!

attorneys.name: Thomas Clark
attorneys.practice_type: ERISA Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Tom Clark serves as the firm's Chief Operating Officer and leads the firm's St. Louis office. His expertise encompasses all aspects of employee benefits programs, including the design, implementation and compliance of retirement plans, health and welfare plans, and executive and incentive compensation arrangements. He also has a robust practice assisting covered service providers in meeting their ERISA compliance needs. Mr. Clark's vast litigation experience complements the firm's strong and growing ERISA and employment litigation department and includes work on landmark ERISA cases involving complicated ERISA fiduciary duty issues. He has been quoted extensively as an ERISA and employee benefits expert by outlets such as Reuters, the Associated Press, Bloomberg, and Forbes. Mr. Clark teaches ERISA fiduciary law as an Adjunct Professor at The Washington University in St. Louis School of Law, his alma mater. He is a co-author of the Second Edition of "ERISA: Principles of Employee Benefits Law," the only treatise of its kind that provides an overview of the regulation of employee benefit plans by highlighting the central principles and competing policies of employee benefits law in a compact and accessible format for a broad audience of readers.

Family law cases can be long and complicated, resulting in lots of questions and concerns about your situation. You need a lawyer you can trust to handle the stresses and problems that may arise during your case and that can effectively help you get back on your feet. William "Bill" Cook is a caring Team Leader Attorney for Stange Law Firm, PC in Springfield, Missouri with over 30 years of legal & business experience. He can assist clients throughout Greene Country and surrounding areas.

Bill attended law school at the Georgetown University Law Center in Washington, DC, graduating cum laude, in May 1991. Before studying law, Bill earned his Bachelor of Arts degree in Biology from Colorado College in Colorado Springs, CO, also graduating cum laude, in 1987. He is licensed and ready to help clients in the State of Missouri.

Before joining the Springfield, MO family law attorneys at Stange Law Firm, PC, Bill has gained vast experience in the legal field, including founding and serving as the Principal for a consulting firm for almost 20 years where he was tasked with providing legal and business planning services to entrepreneurs and companies. In this role, he worked directly with senior management, reviewing and improving clients' contract management procedures, drafting and revising form contracts and service agreements, reviewing and improving clients' HR practices and employment agreements, and providing legal advice and business analysis with respect to major strategic partnerships, mergers & acquisitions, strategic realignments, downsizing, bankruptcy, and corporate finance. Bill is excited to work with his clients to help them rebuild their lives.

Disclaimer: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements. Kirk C. Stange and Stange Law Firm, PC are responsible for the content. Principal place of business 120 S. Central Avenue, Suite 450, St. Louis (Clayton), MO 63105.

attorneys.name: Robert W. Cornejo
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Columbia, MO
attorneys.bio:
Robert is a native St. Louisan who received his B.A. in 2005 from Washington University in St. Louis where he was a standout member and captain of the varsity football team. After graduating from college, Robert continued his studies and graduated from the University of Missouri-Columbia School of Law in 2008. While still in law school, Robert started working for the Debt Relief Law Center of Missouri. Upon graduating with his law degree, Robert became a full-time associate with the law firm. In November 2009, Robert opened up the O'Fallon branch of the Debt Relief Law Center of Missouri and currently manages that office. Robert and his wife currently reside in St. Peters along with Busch, their Chocolate Labradoodle, who was named after the home stadium of their favorite St. Louis Cardinals. Robert and his wife are also active members in their community and church.

Robert is licensed to practice law in the state courts of Missouri and Illinois. Additionally, he is admitted to practice in the Eastern District of Missouri and Western District of Missouri. Robert is a member of the National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys (NACBA). While in law school, Robert had two casenotes published in the Missouri Environmental Law and Policy Review . Robert was published a third time, when he was selected to co-author the Consumer Law Handbook published by The Missouri Bar.

Dissolution of marriages, legal separations, annulments, establishing paternity, establishing custody, establishing visitation, child support, grandparent's rights, domestic violence restraining orders, temporary orders of protection, adoptions, name changes, emancipation, prenuptial agreements, post/antenuptial agreements, and modifications of existing court judgments.

Also, Joan has had extensive experience as a Guardian ad Litem, advocating for the best interest of children during court proceedings.

attorneys.name: John Cowherd
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Monett, MO
attorneys.bio:
John was raised on a dairy farm south of Purdy and graduated from Cassville High School in 1978. Like his 5 brothers, John graduated from Mizzou. John received an Ag Econ degree in 1981 and a law degree in 1985 from Mizzou Law School where he was on the Dean’s List and Law Review. After Law School John practiced for 3 years in a litigation law firm in Springfield and then moved to Mount Vernon where he and his wife Lynne have raised 5 wonderful children. John focuses his practice on personal injury, wrongful death, and workers compensation cases. He is a past president of the Missouri Bar Young Lawyers’ Section, a former member of the Board of Governors of the Missouri Bar, and past Chair of the MoBar Continuing Legal Education Committee. For the past 19 years John has served as a bar examiner (i.e., grading essay bar exams) for the Missouri Supreme Court’s Board of Law Examiners. John is also a lay pastor and enjoys bible study, reading good biographies, making pizza, hanging out with his awesome wife, and watching Mizzou football.

attorneys.name: Bryan Cox
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
With eight years of experience in defense and civil litigation, Bryan Cox brings a wealth of experience and expertise to our team. Bryan practices in a variety of areas of civil litigation, with an emphasis on defending professional negligence cases.

Before joining McDonald Law Group, P.A., Bryan worked at Norris, Keplinger, Hicks & Welder, where he defended professional and business clients in medical negligence, civil rights, construction, and trucking matters. Prior to private practice, he defended indigent clients as a public defender first at the trial level and later before the Kansas Court of Appeals and Kansas Supreme Court.

Bryan earned his undergraduate degree in political science and economics from Kansas State University. He holds a juris doctorate from Washburn University, and an LLM from the University of Maastricht in the Netherlands.

Bryan is a member of the Missouri, Kansas, and District of Columbia bars, and is admitted to practice before the United States District Court of Kansas as well as the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation.

attorneys.bio:
Kett Craven's practice is focused primarily in personal injury, general litigation, and wills, trusts, and estates. Kett returned to private practice in 2017 after nearly 20 years working as an attorney and claims manager at an insurance company. He holds the Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter designation, and his understanding of the insurance industry, the mechanics of insurance policies, and the claims process allows him to communicate well with insurance adjusters and other insurance personnel, and to readily grasp what has happened in an insurance claim, before and after suit has been filed.

attorneys.name: Helen M Cripps
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Columbia, MO
attorneys.bio:
Helen practices law in the areas of estate, business and tax planning; estate and trust administration; and elder law - the same areas which have been her focus for thirty years. She has helped many individuals and families understand and navigate the complexities of planning for their own and future generations. She believes every plan should be customized for individual situations as well as provide for contingencies.

Motivated by a strong belief in the value of educating clients as the first step in planning, Helen is frequently asked to speak to civic and professional organizations on the topics of estate planning, special needs, elder law and probate avoidance. Helen is active in community organizations related to her practice areas, including the Mid-Missouri Estate Planning Council. She regularly attends advanced continuing education programs so she can stay current on the always changing laws and planning techniques available for clients.

Helen and her husband have four grown daughters. They enjoy driving national scenic byways, visiting national parks, wine tasting and visiting their daughters.

Helen practices law in the areas of estate, business and tax planning; estate and trust administration; and elder law - the same areas which have been her focus for thirty years. She has helped many individuals and families understand and navigate the complexities of planning for their own and future generations. She believes every plan should be customized for individual situations as well as provide for contingencies.

Motivated by a strong belief in the value of educating clients as the first step in planning, Helen is frequently asked to speak to civic and professional organizations on the topics of estate planning, special needs, elder law and probate avoidance. Helen is active in community organizations related to her practice areas, including the Mid-Missouri Estate Planning Council. She regularly attends advanced continuing education programs so she can stay current on the always changing laws and planning techniques available for clients.

Helen and her husband have four grown daughters. They enjoy driving national scenic byways, visiting national parks, wine tasting and visiting their daughters.

attorneys.name: Timothy M. Cronin
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Timothy M. Cronin is an attorney with The Simon Law Firm, P.C., in St. Louis, Missouri. A top-rated and highly skilled trial law lawyer with more than thirteen years of legal experience, Mr. Cronin devotes his practice to advocating on behalf of the rights of plaintiff clients throughout Missouri and the surrounding areas of Illinois who suffered an injury or loss as the result of defective products, medical malpractice, dangerous property conditions, trucking accidents or other preventable tragedies.

Passionate about seeing justice served for those suffering through no fault of their own, Mr. Cronin has achieved considerable success advocating on behalf of his clients in state and federal courts. He has secured more than $250 million in total compensation for his clients, including at least 40 verdicts and settlements over a million dollars and recovering in excess of four million dollars on over half of those cases. At all turns, he delivers highly compassionate counsel and dedicated support as he aggressively pursues the most favorable outcomes possible for those he serves.

Recognized for his impeccable professionalism and outstanding legal abilities, Mr. Cronin has earned consistent recognition from "The Best Lawyers in America©" each year since 2017. He has also received many other accolades from his peers, who regard him as one of the leading plaintiff personal injury attorneys in his region.

A 2005 graduate of the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign with a Bachelor of Science in Economics, Mr. Cronin began his legal career in 2010 after obtaining his Juris Doctor magna cum laude from Saint Louis University School of Law and his license to practice from The Missouri Bar. He also holds his license to practice in Illinois, and he is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Eastern and Western Districts of Missouri and the Southern District of Illinois.

Mr. Cronin is an active member of the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis, the St. Clair County Bar Association, the East St. Louis Bar Association and the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, among his other professional affiliations.

attorneys.name: Dan Cuneo
attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Fathers are frequently the underdogs in a family law case, which is one of the reasons Dan Cuneo got into family law.

"I enjoy helping dads and giving them a fighting chance to be with their children," Mr. Cuneo said. "I always like when we're successful in getting our clients the amount of parenting time they deserve."

Mr. Cuneo advises clients to ensure they are being open and honest with their attorney and effectively communicate their goals and expectations. Divorce is an emotional time in a person's life, but letting emotions get in the way of goals can hinder a case.

"You are not only investing in your future, but the future of your family," Mr. Cuneo said.

attorneys.name: Kelly Davidzuk Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
When you hire an attorney, you want to make sure that they are driven, passionate and will work hard for your rights. That's how Kelly Davidzuk works everyday in her family law practice at Stange Law Firm, PC as the Managing Partner, while also managing the Central Region of the firm in Missouri in Clayton, Ellisville, Union, Columbia, Troy and the St. Louis City (by appointment) office. To help out families with their legal needs, Kelly is also a trained mediator and collaborative law attorney.

Kelly earned her Juris Doctorate degree from the Appalachian School of Law in Virginia. Kelly worked hard in law school and continued to work hard in the area of family law and other areas of civil litigation before she joined the team at Stange Law Firm, PC. Kelly has worked for the firm since 2011. She is licensed to practice in Missouri, Kansas and Oklahoma.

Kelly has spoken at continuing legal education seminars through the National Business Institute. She has also received numerous awards from organizations such as Lead Counsel, the National Advocates, the National Academy of Family Law attorneys and others. Kelly is also the Treasurer of the Missouri Collaborative Institute. Kelly was also named to the Rising Stars list for Missouri/Kansas Super Lawyers in 2020.

After living in the Appalachian Mountains during law school, Kelly moved back to her hometown of St. Charles, Missouri. Kelly met her husband shortly after returning to Missouri and settled down in the Lake St. Louis area. In her spare time, Kelly loves nothing more than to spend time with her husband and two sons at all of the outdoor St. Louis Family hot spots. Kelly also loves hockey, soccer and international travel.

attorneys.name: John Davis
attorneys.practice_type: White Collar Crimes Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
John Davis joined KesslerWilliams in 2020 after serving as an Assistant United States Attorney in the United States District Court, Eastern District of Missouri, for more than twenty-three years. As an Assistant United States Attorney, Mr. Davis was assigned to the Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Force. He supervised and assisted investigations of major narcotic conspiracies, money laundering, asset forfeiture, federal firearm offenses, and federal bomb and arson offenses. These investigations involved the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), United States Postal Inspection Service, Department of Homeland Security, Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF), and numerous other federal and state agencies. As a result, Mr. Davis is very experienced in global positioning system (GPS) tracking, wiretaps, and other electronic means of investigation. His post-investigation courtroom experience includes federal grand jury practice, extensive federal jury and bench trials, and appellate matters before the United States 8th Circuit Court of Appeals.

Prior to becoming an Assistant United States Attorney, Mr. Davis was elected Associate Circuit Judge of the 11th Circuit in St. Charles County, Missouri. Before taking the bench, Mr. Davis' litigation career began as an Assistant Prosecuting Attorney in the St. Charles County Prosecuting Attorney's Office, where he gained extensive trial experience in felony, misdemeanor, and traffic matters on the state level. He also practiced before the Missouri Court of Appeals for the Eastern District.

Mr. Davis has over 20 years of experience as an adjunct professor of criminal justice at Lindenwood University. His teaching experience includes Constitutional Law, Criminal Investigations, Criminal Justice, and the Law of Evidence.

A native of Peoria, Illinois, he graduated from Bradley University, with a B.S. in Administration of Criminal Justice, and Saint Louis University School of Law.

Honors

“Top Ten Young Missourians of 1995” by Missouri Jaycees, February 1995

Certificate of appreciation from Federal Bureau of Investigation for outstanding prosecution of United States v Parsley et al., January 2001

Certificate of appreciation from Federal Bureau of Investigation for outstanding prosecution of United States v Bond et al., January 2001

Meritorious Achievement Award from the United States Attorney’s Office for outstanding investigation and prosecution of Drug Enforcement Administration’s “Operation Dog Catcher,” May 2001

Certificate of appreciation from Drug Enforcement Administration for outstanding prosecution of United States v. Katz, M.D., August 2005

Certificate of appreciation from Federal Bureau of Investigation for outstanding investigation and prosecution of “Operation Hit the Deck,” December 2012

Awarded outstanding investigation of the year by the United States Attorney’s Office for United States v. Anderson et al., December 2017

As an Assistant United States Attorney, Mr. Davis was assigned to the Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Force. He supervised and assisted investigations of major narcotic conspiracies, money laundering, asset forfeiture, federal firearm offenses, and federal bomb and arson offenses. These investigations involved the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), United States Postal Inspection Service, Department of Homeland Security, Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF), and numerous other federal and state agencies. As a result, Mr. Davis is very experienced in global positioning system (GPS) tracking, wiretaps, and other electronic means of investigation. His post-investigation courtroom experience includes federal grand jury practice, extensive federal jury and bench trials, and appellate matters before the United States 8th Circuit Court of Appeals.

Prior to becoming an Assistant United States Attorney, Mr. Davis was elected Associate Circuit Judge of the 11th Circuit in St. Charles County, Missouri. Before taking the bench, Mr. Davis' litigation career began as an Assistant Prosecuting Attorney in the St. Charles County Prosecuting Attorney's Office, where he gained extensive trial experience in felony, misdemeanor, and traffic matters on the state level. He also practiced before the Missouri Court of Appeals for the Eastern District.

Mr. Davis has over 20 years of experience as an adjunct professor of criminal justice at Lindenwood University. His teaching experience includes Constitutional Law, Criminal Investigations, Criminal Justice, and the Law of Evidence.

A native of Peoria, Illinois, he graduated from Bradley University, with a B.S. in Administration of Criminal Justice, and Saint Louis University School of Law.

attorneys.name: Emily DeFoor
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Emily DeFoor is an attorney who approaches every case with compassion, dedication, and a strong sense of purpose. She was drawn to the practice of law by the opportunity to help people through some of the most difficult moments of their lives, easing their stress while advocating for their best interests.

Emily takes pride in ensuring that her clients feel heard, supported, and confident throughout the legal process. She builds her client relationships on trust, striving to create an environment where clients know she will fight tirelessly for them while keeping them informed every step of the way.

Starting in Family Law, some of Emily’s most defining moments in her career were moments of bringing families the support they needed during a difficult time within the legal system. This includes helping a grandmother regain visitation with her granddaughter after three years of no contact, as well as advocating for a mother’s right to provide the mental health care needed for her child. Experiences like these have reinforced Emily’s commitment to achieving meaningful results for her clients.

A Kansas City native, Emily grew up in Overland Park and later returned to practice in her hometown community. Outside of work, she enjoys gardening, cooking and baking, tackling DIY projects, painting, and hosting friends and family. She also loves spending time with her three dogs.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
When clients look for a divorce or family law attorney, they look for someone who is personable and who is going to fight for them. Dzenana Delic strives to be the attorney that clients can lean on through their hard time. Growing up in Bosnia and Herzegovina and moving to St. Louis, Missouri at the age of twelve as a result of a civil war in her home country, Dzenana knows hardship and the importance of family through that time.

Dzenana is a bi-lingual attorney who speaks English and Bosnian and strives to help the Bosnian community of the St. Louis area with their family law needs.

Dzenana received her Juris Doctorate from Valparaiso University School of Law in Northwest Indiana. Since then, she has focused her practice on family law matters out of the West County office of Stange Law Firm, PC.

When not helping clients through their family law needs, Dzenana enjoys Crossfit training as well as riding her bicycle on Grant's Trail. Dzenana also loves shopping for the latest fashion trend and making sure she is up to date on all styles. She is a fanatic for St. Louis Bread Co., so you can usually find her there around lunch time.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Ryan Demore
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Ryan came to DM Injury Law with a strong foundation as a former securities attorney, where he helped clients transform entrepreneurial dreams into reality. His work has supported clients who were featured on Shark Tank, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, and more. While that chapter of his career was rewarding, Ryan discovered an even deeper calling—advocating for individuals who’ve been injured and wronged.

During his time with DM Injury Law, Ryan has dedicated his legal practice exclusively to personal injury law. During this time, he has represented clients in a wide range of cases—from car accidents to premises liability—and has been relentless in pursuing justice and fair compensation for those whose lives have been upended by someone else’s negligence.

Born and raised in Springfield, Missouri, Ryan brings a diverse background to his legal work, with experience ranging from student leadership roles to managing teams at a Fortune 30 telecommunications company. Yet through it all, his commitment to becoming an attorney never wavered. He earned his law degree from the University of Missouri School of Law, where he served as president of the Student Bar Association.

As an attorney, Ryan is known for his ability to truly listen. He values building genuine relationships with clients, guiding them with transparency, empathy, and strategic insight. He approaches each case with meticulous attention to detail and sees it as an honor to help clients navigate some of the most difficult periods of their lives.

attorneys.bio:
Cathleen was born in Columbia, Missouri and was raised in Sikeston, Missouri. She attended the University of Miami (FL) where she earned her bachelor’s degree in business administration with an emphasis on accounting and legal studies. While at the University of Miami, she was a member of the honors program and graduated cum laude.

She obtained her Juris Doctorate from University of Missouri School of Law in Columbia, Missouri. During law school, she held numerous leadership positions in the school’s premier legal organizations. Cathleen was also awarded the CALI Excellence for the Future Award for her achievements in the study of elder law.

While in law school, Cathleen attended the Institute on World Legal Problems in Innsbruck, Austria, where she studied under United States Supreme Court Judge Antonin Scalia. She gained additional legal experience by working in the Office of Chief Counsel in St. Louis, Missouri while in school.

Her practice not only includes a high concentration of product liability litigation, but all personal injury litigation including auto accidents, workplace accidents, medical malpractice and trucking accidents.

Cathleen was admitted to the Missouri Bar in 2010 and is a member of the Missouri Bar and the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis.

attorneys.name: Blaine Dickeson
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Dickeson Law Office was founded by attorney Blaine Dickeson, a Kansas City area native and lifetime resident.

Prior to founding Dickeson Law Office, Blaine worked as a trial lawyer for large area law firms specializing in creditors' rights and personal injury litigation.

Blaine advised and represented banks and other lenders for years prior to opening his own law firm, and has extensive experience in handling all variety of consumer and commercial matters relating to: loan defaults; credit card defaults; foreclosure and eviction; automobile, boat and equipment repossession and liquidation; debt collection; judgment execution and garnishment; bankruptcy; fraud and lender liability; real estate disputes; and consumer protection violations.

After graduating from law school, Blaine worked for major insurance companies defending claims involving traffic accidents, wrongful death, premises liability, defamation, workplace injury and other serious tort claims.

At Dickeson Law Office, Blaine is now able to use the skills he developed through representing big banks and insurance companies to protect the rights of the injured, the wronged, and the average consumer faced with lawsuits, foreclosure or harassment from debt collectors and creditors.

Blaine Dickeson is first and foremost a litigator and has achieved favorable results for his clients through settlement, trial or on appeal.

Blaine is honored to have been selected a "Rising Star" by Missouri & Kansas Super Lawyers - 2011.

attorneys.bio:
Ryan Dickherber joined OnderLaw in 2023 following more than a decade of experience in representing individuals who have developed cancer as a result of exposures to asbestos or other hazardous chemicals. Before joining OnderLaw, he established himself as a respected lawyer in product liability litigation.

Ryan excels in every aspect of his cases from conducting depositions, arguing motions, negotiating settlements, and trial. He has litigated cases in multiple jurisdictions including California, Illinois, Missouri, New York, Pennsylvania, and others resulting in millions of dollars of recovery against some of the largest corporations in the United States.

Ryan’s proven track record of success has been recognized by The Best Lawyers in America and The National Trial Lawyers. In 2022, Ryan was recognized as one of the best personal injury lawyers in St. Louis, Missouri by The Best Lawyers in America. He has been honored by The National Trial Lawyers as Top 40 under 40 and Top 100 Civil Plaintiff Lawyers. Ryan is an engaged member of legal associations, including the Missouri Association of Trial Lawyers and Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis.

Ryan earned his Juris Doctor from Saint Louis University School of Law, where he distinguished himself in Honors Moot Court and ranked among the Top 50 trial advocates in the country while serving on the Trial Advocacy.

attorneys.name: Michael DiPasquale
attorneys.practice_type: Pre Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Michael DiPasquale, the Founding Partner at DM Injury Law, has always been passionate about fighting for the rights of the injured. He first began pursuing a career in law because he wanted to make a difference in the lives of those around him, which he does both in and out of the courtroom.

Michael was raised in Kansas and went on to attend school at the University of San Diego in California, where he played football for four years. Shortly after earning his bachelor’s degree, he returned to Kansas to earn his Juris Doctorate and began working as a lawyer defending insurance companies and large corporations. After working on this side of several cases, Michael quickly realized he wanted to put his legal experience to good use by defending the rights of the wrongfully injured.

Now known as Kansas City’s football personal injury lawyer, Michael focuses on providing injured individuals and families with the type of steadfast representation they both need and deserve. He fights for the rights of clients in a variety of serious situations, especially involving car accidents, medical malpractice, defective products, workplace injuries, slip and fall accidents, and wrongful death. Michael’s legal knowledge and trial experience make him an effective, aggressive representative, but it’s his personal, creative legal solutions that truly make his guidance and support invaluable.

Call Michael and his team if you’ve been hurt in an accident and are dealing with medical bills or time off work. Remember, Mike’s Got This!

attorneys.name: Jordan Dollar
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Bad Faith Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jordan Dollar is a gifted attorney with a wide-range of litigation experience that allows him to see the legal industry from every possible angle.

Over the span of his career he has worked for a United States Senator, at the Missouri Court of Appeals Western District, as a clerk at the United States District Court – Western District of Missouri, and practiced at another private law firm. This time spent in judges’ chambers and the legislative branch gives him a distinct advantage in and outside of the courtroom.

Despite working in some of the most powerful centers of justice in our country, being able to directly help people get through the toughest time of their lives was what Jordan was meant to do.

From a young age, Jordan was inspired by his father’s work representing those who had been catastrophically injured or killed due to the negligence of others. He knew he wanted to become an advocate for those victims.

By immersing himself in all facets of the law prior to coming to Dollar, Burns, Becker & Hershewe, he was able to build a solid foundation of knowledge including preparing for and participating in oral arguments, drafting motions for summary judgment and dismissal, and preparing trial materials for both civil and criminal cases. Since joining the firm, he has argued in front of both the Missouri Court of Appeals – Western District and Missouri Circuit Court. In addition, he has also drafted petitions, discovery and motions.

Not only has all this prepared him to be the voice of change for victims, but also further cemented the idea that unforeseen and unfortunate things happen to people every day, and our legal system can help bring not only justice to the guilty, but peace to the wronged.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
It’s no surprise Tim Dollar is considered one of the top trial lawyers in America. He has tried more than 286 jury trials, has won hundreds of millions of dollars for his clients and orchestrated major company and legislative policy changes that make our world safer.

This includes cases he tried as a special prosecutor for the Jackson County, Missouri Prosecutor’s Office. Tim is so effective that Jackson County has continued to contract with him for important homicide cases each year since 1986.

Some of his most noteworthy cases include the Precious Doe case, KC Wolf case, Bresette vs. Birmingham-Shuttlesworth International Airport case and many more. When it matters most, Tim Dollar is the man you want to be your voice of change.

attorneys.name: Jonathan W. Doss
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Hillsboro, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan, a partner since 2021, was born and raised in St. Louis, MO and graduated from Parkway West High School. He attended the University of Missouri-Kansas City, earning a Bachelor of Arts in Chemistry, magna cum laude and earned his law degree from The University of Missouri-Columbia in May 2017. While at law school, he also earned a certificate in tax and transactional law with an emphasis on estate planning.

During his time in law school, Jonathan earned CALI awards for excellence, given to those earning the highest grade in a class, for both pre-trial litigation and law practice management. Jonathan represents clients in all phases of litigation, from early dispute resolution to appellate advocacy. His practice is concentrated on general civil litigation with an emphasis on personal injury, employment matters, and business disputes. Additionally, Jonathan helps clients in business transactions, including stock sales and buy outs.

Every year since 2021 Jonathan has been selected as a Super Lawyers Rising Star for the State of Missouri, which is limited to 2.5% of lawyers in the state under the age of 40. Jonathan is licensed to practice in the state of Missouri and licensed for both the Eastern and Western District Federal Courts in the state of Missouri.

Jonathan currently serves as district representative for the Young Lawyer Section Council of the Missouri Bar, is a member of the Missouri Bar, Jefferson County Bar Association, and the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis.

In his free time, Jonathan enjoys hunting and fishing, hiking, and participating in triathlon events.

attorneys.name: Jennifer J. Dougan
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Platte City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jennifer Dougan has lived in the Northland her entire life and welcomes the chance to give back to her community. The Northland community voted Jennifer's law firm "Best of the Northland" in 2011. Jennifer has a wealth of experience outside of the legal field., which has given her a clear understanding of the need for superior customer service. Prior to attending law school, she was a division manager of a company that performed utility maintenance and construction contracting services for local utilities and municipalities. Additionally, she worked for the federal government for approximately five years. These experiences combined allow her to understand issues from a client's perspective. She prides herself on her ability to provide the type of customer service that her clients deserve.

Jennifer graduated summa cum laude, with a Bachelor's of Public Administration, from Park University located in Parkville, Missouri. She obtained her Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Missouri - Kansas City School of Law. While in law school she clerked for the Clay County Prosecutor's Office, Commissioner Sherrill Rosen in Jackson County, and a local Northland attorney. Jennifer was the vice president of the Association of Women Law Students and co-president of the Family Law Society. She also participated in the Family and Child Services Clinic which allowed her to appear before the court as a student attorney (Rule 13) on multiple cases.

Jennifer is a member of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association, The Missouri Bar Association, The Clay County Bar Association and the Platte County Bar Association. She is licensed to practice in Missouri and the Western District of Missouri Federal Court.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey L. Dull
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury / Wrongful Death Lawyers in Clinton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jeff Dull graduated from Lakeland High School in May of 1980 and continued his education at Central Missouri State University where he graduated with honors in May of 1984 receiving degrees in Finance and Management. Mr. Dull received his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City in May of 1987 and was admitted to the Missouri Bar in October of 1987.

Mr. Dull began his practice in Osceola, Missouri, where he handled a wide variety of cases, including personal injury, criminal, domestic, probate, workers’ compensation, and social security disability cases and claims. In 2003, Mr. Dull established an office in Clinton, Missouri; the firm also has an office in Warsaw, Missouri, and in 2018, Dull Law LLC opened a third office in Sedalia, Missouri.

In the past several years Mr. Dull has focused his practice in the areas of personal injury and wrongful death litigation, workers’ compensation claims, complex civil and probate matters, and social security disability claims. Mr. Dull has handled hundreds of cases in these areas of the law and finds great satisfaction in assisting clients who have sustained serious injuries and disabilities. Mr. Dull has handled several cases where he has obtained judgments or settlements for seriously injured clients in excess of a million dollars.

For more than 20 years, Mr. Dull has received a rating of BV Distinguished under Martindale-Hubbell’s peer review system and in 2023 he received a rating of AV Preeminent which is the highest peer review rating issued. He is also a member of the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys. In 2019 he was recognized by the National Trial Lawyers as a “Top 100 Civil Plaintiff’s Lawyer” and in 2020 as a “Top 25 Attorney in Motor Vehicle Accident Cases”.

Jeff lives on a family farm with his wife Stephanie where they raised their 3 sons and where they operate a small cattle operation and enjoy the peace and tranquility of the country. Over the years, Jeff has been active in community affairs serving as President of a local school board, President of a local hospital board, and served on the Board of Directors for a local bank.

attorneys.name: Matthew J. Eddy
attorneys.practice_type: Product Liability / Toxic Tort Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Eddy is a litigator and trial lawyer with experience in both state and federal courts, focusing his practice on the defense of complex litigation and health care regulatory matters. Matt has tried cases before juries and judges, and has defended and pursued his clients’ interests in appeals before courts and administrative bodies in Missouri and Illinois.

His practice includes defending medical negligence, product liability and toxic tort lawsuits, advising a wide spectrum of health care clients in government investigations relating to Medicare-Medicaid fraud and abuse, false claims and anti-kickback laws, and professional licensure disciplinary actions. Matt also regularly counsels clients who have been served subpoenas and civil investigative demands from the Department of Justice, Office of Inspector General, state and federal drug agencies, state licensure boards and private parties involved in civil litigation, among others. He has successfully litigated insurance disputes involving claims for coverage, breach of contract, bad faith and contribution.

His accomplishments also include successful representation of product manufacturers, retailers and owners in product liability actions involving consumer products, industrial machinery, medical devices, asbestos, silica, chemical solvents and herbicides. Matt is a partner in the firm’s Health Care and Litigation practice groups.

Matt has been selected for inclusion to the Missouri & Kansas Super Lawyers (Personal Injury Medical Malpractice: Defense), most recently in 2014. He earned his J.D. from the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law.

attorneys.bio:
John M. Edgar is the Managing Partner of Edgar Law Firm LLC. He and his sons John F. and David W. Edgar founded the firm in 2002 to provide businesses with the responsive, personal service they need in high stakes litigation. Their ability to move cases to court quickly and efficiently has resulted in numerous settlements for their clients in the past six years. Edgar has over 40 years of lead trial experience practicing in federal and state courts throughout the U.S. While he now practices exclusively on behalf of plaintiffs, he spent many years on the defense side of the courtroom. He served in a management role at Stinson Mag & Fizzell (now Stinson Morrison Hecker with 360 attorneys), later leaving to establish and become Managing Partner of the Kansas City office of Bryan Cave (currently more than 1,100 attorneys firm wide). In Sugar Creek v. A settlement was reached, as Station Casinos reported in its public filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and Station Casinos paid our clients $38 million.

attorneys.name: John F. Edgar
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
John F. Edgar is one of the founding partners of Edgar Law Firm LLC. The Firm was founded in 2002 to provide clients with the responsive, personal service they require in high-stakes, complex litigation.

Edgar is well known for his work in complex commercial and class action litigation in courts throughout the country. Clients turn to Edgar counting on his courtroom skills and strategy in high-profile litigation where the last thing the client needs is a large law firm charging massive hourly rates. Indeed, Edgar believes that the attorney and client create a team working together in order to reach the ultimate goals of the client. Edgar's clients receive personal and responsive communication, as well as regular updates about the client's pending matter. It is Edgar's philosophy to move the client's matter to trial in the most quick and efficient manner possible.

Over his extensive career, Edgar has served as lead counsel in a multitude of successful, highly publicized commercial and class actions against some of the largest corporations in the world, and also against some of the largest law firms in the world representing them. In one such case, Edgar served as co-lead trial counsel in one of the longest jury trials in the history of the United States. Edgar has successfully prosecuted matters in the areas of commercial litigation, fraud/misrepresentation, breach of contract, legal malpractice, securities, and other business torts. He has also prosecuted hundreds of class actions in the areas of consumer protection, product liability/defective products, environmental contamination, securities, wage/overtime, antitrust, and ERISA/employee benefits.

Edgar serves in key leadership roles throughout the legal and business communities and serves on the Board of Governors for the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys. He is a former Board member of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association. John F. Edgar was born and raised in Kansas City, Missouri. He currently lives in Leawood, Kansas with his wife Keiko, and his four children Isabella, Emma, Deya, and Sloane. Edgar enjoys spending time with his family, as well as playing an occasional round of golf.

attorneys.name: Oscar Espinoza
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury - Plaintiff Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Oscar Espinoza has several years of experience litigating wrongful death and neglect cases, as well as working on the defense side of personal injury law. These experiences have helped shape him into the skilled lawyer he is and have given him unique insight when approaching and evaluating cases.

Born in Managua, Nicaragua, Oscar immigrated to the United States with his family at just nine years old. As someone who speaks fluent Spanish, he has a personal understanding of the need for Spanish-speaking attorneys who can effectively serve the Hispanic community. He decided to pursue a career in law due to a desire to make a difference in the lives of individuals and help them understand their legal rights and the legal process. He also finds law to be fascinating and challenging, and appreciates the fact that he’ll never stop learning in his role.

As an attorney, Oscar believes in the importance of developing a solid attorney-client relationship. This begins with building good rapport, trust, and communication early on in the process. He takes the time to educate clients regarding the law and how it applies to their specific case. This helps to prevent misunderstandings and allows the client to make informed decisions about their case. His top priority is the well-being of clients, and he approaches all of his cases by focusing on telling the human story and the impact that injuries have on a client’s life.

In his free time, Oscar enjoys cheering on our local teams (KU basketball, Chiefs, Royals) and the Baylor Bears, traveling, spending time with family and friends, and watching his son play competitive baseball. He is an active member of the community and serves as a board member at KidsTLC in Olathe. He is also a member of the Hispanic Chamber of Commerce of Greater Kansas City, which has allowed him to network with business leaders in the KC community.

attorneys.practice_type: Elder Law Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Brigid Fernandez graduated from Saint Louis University School of Law in 2006 where she received the Academic Excellence Award in Legal Profession for achieving the highest grade. Her first case was tried as a third year law student. She was later recognized for her commitment to public service when she was awarded the 2006 Saint Louis University School of Law David Grant Student Attorney Award. Brigid is a Certified Civil Mediator.

In addition to her law degree, Ms. Fernandez has a Bachelor's Degree and a Master's Degree of Social Work from the University of Missouri-Columbia. She is also a Licensed Clinical Social Worker.

After nearly twenty years as a highly respected social worker in one of the largest healthcare systems in the State of Missouri, Brigid attained her law degree in order to continue her support for older adults and persons with disabilities. Her unique combination of education and experience makes her a strong advocate for her clients and their families, offering a rare and valuable insight of the inner mechanisms of the healthcare system and long-term care facilities.

attorneys.bio:
Ms. Lynn Fischer will personally handle your case and be fully devoted to your legal needs. She works diligently for each of her clients, fighting for their rights and maximizing their entitled settlement. Throughout her career, she has negotiated settlements totaling millions of dollars. Ms. Fischer is licensed to practice law in the states of Illinois and Missouri.

attorneys.name: Kelvin J. Fisher
attorneys.firm_name: Kevin McManus Law: Kansas City Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Kelvin Fisher: From Defense to Fierce Advocacy

Kelvin Fisher has spent most of his life in Kansas City, where his passion for law was sparked during a high school mock trial competition. That experience ignited a lifelong commitment to advocacy and justice, ultimately driving him to pursue a career in law. His journey began in defense work, where he spent over a decade meticulously analyzing cases and crafting strategic defenses. However, his perspective shifted, and he felt a stronger calling—to advocate for individuals who had suffered harm due to the negligence of others.

Now as a plaintiff’s attorney, Kelvin brings a unique perspective to his work. His deep understanding of defense strategies allows him to anticipate and counter the tactics of insurance companies, ensuring that his clients receive the strongest possible representation. Kelvin is passionate about helping clients secure the compensation they deserve, and he remains dedicated to guiding them through what is often one of the most challenging times of their lives.

Advocating for Maximum Recovery

Kelvin’s role at the firm is centered around empowering clients who have been injured due to negligence or wrongdoing. He provides strategic legal guidance to ensure clients understand their rights, legal options, and the process ahead. His approach is rooted in compassionate communication, allowing clients to feel supported and informed throughout their case.

Having spent most of his career representing insurance companies, Kelvin understands firsthand how these corporations operate. It was this experience that ultimately led him to transition to plaintiff work—where he could genuinely make a difference in the lives of injured individuals and their families. His mission is clear: to pursue maximum compensation for his clients while leveling the playing field against large insurance companies.

A Life of Service and Leadership

In addition to his work at the firm, Kelvin has made significant contributions to the legal community and his local community. He has served as a Missouri Disciplinary Hearing Officer and a former member of the Missouri Disciplinary Committee, where he worked to uphold the highest standards of legal ethics. His leadership extends to his past role as a member of the Planning Commission for the City of Independence, Missouri, as well as his involvement with several non-profit organizations.

Kelvin’s dedication to service extends beyond the legal world. He previously served as a board member for the Dream Factory of Greater Kansas City and the Truman Heritage Habitat for Humanity. His commitment to helping others—both professionally and personally—reflects his belief that real impact comes from advocating for those who need it most.

Notable Accomplishments:

Member of Million Dollar Advocates Forum, which is limited to lawyers who have obtained verdicts or settlements valued in the millions of dollars. Less than 1% of all the attorneys in United States qualify and become members of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

AV® Preeminent Rated by Martindale-Hubbell®

Licensed in state and federal courts in Missouri and Kansas

Current Missouri Disciplinary Hearing Officer

Former Missouri Disciplinary Committee Member

Graduate of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association’s Leadership Academy

Recognized by Super Lawyers Magazine as a “Rising Star”

Recognized as a Super Lawyers by Super Lawyers Magazine

Recognized by Missouri Lawyers Weekly as an “Up and Coming Lawyer”

Former member of the Planning Commission for the City of Independence, Missouri

Former board member of the Dream Factory of Greater Kansas City

Former board member of the Truman Heritage Habitat for Humanity

Member of the KBA Commission of Professionalism that drafted the “Pillars of Professionalism” still used by the Kansas Supreme Court to guide Kansas lawyers.

Beyond the Office

Outside the office, Kelvin is deeply engaged in his community and family life. He is an active presence in the lives of his three young sons, regularly attending their school functions, sports games, and scouting activities. In his free time, Kelvin enjoys fishing, reading, watching spy thrillers and professional wrestling, and attending local wrestling events.

Kelvin’s career path has been driven by a strong desire to make a meaningful impact—whether in the courtroom or in his community. He believes that true advocacy means standing up for those who feel powerless and ensuring they receive the justice they deserve. His guiding principle, inspired by Atticus Finch in To Kill a Mockingbird, is simple: “You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view…until you climb in his skin and walk around in it.”

An advocate for justice, Kelvin Fisher is more than just an attorney—he is a fierce advocate, a compassionate advisor, and a dedicated champion for his clients. His extensive background in defense work, coupled with his commitment to fighting for the injured, makes him an invaluable asset to the firm. Whether he’s negotiating settlements, presenting cases, or guiding his clients through complex legal matters, Kelvin’s goal remains the same: to secure the best possible outcome for those who need it most.

attorneys.practice_type: Asbestos Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Since joining O’Brien Law Firm in 2005, Jerry has dedicated his entire legal career to helping men, women and families affected by asbestos disease. With many relatives having worked in the construction trades and as the son of a Local #1 Insulator, Jerry has firsthand knowledge of the damage asbestos exposure can cause. He works very closely with local unions and labor organizations through the Midwest supporting, educating and representing their members. Jerry takes pride in the relationships he has established in labor.

Jerry plays an active role in managing the law firm while personally working up client cases. His efforts in all aspects of the case – from initially meeting with clients, investigating exposures, securing depositions, and negotiating settlements – have resulted in the recovery of millions of dollars in compensation for his clients.

Jerry graduated from St. Louis University High School in 1997. With degrees in political science and business, he graduated from St. Louis University with honors in 2001. Jerry obtained his Juris Doctorate from the University of Dayton School of Law in 2004. He is licensed to practice law in Missouri and Illinois. Jerry currently lives with his wife and children in St. Louis City.

attorneys.name: Melody Fitzgerel
attorneys.firm_name: Kevin McManus Law: Kansas City Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Melody Fitzgerel: An Experienced Advocate for Injured Clients

Melody is a dedicated personal injury attorney with a unique blend of experience in both insurance defense and plaintiff advocacy. Her career began at a prominent defense law firm, where she worked closely with insurance companies, gaining valuable insights into how claims are evaluated, contracts are analyzed, and cases are assessed by insurance adjusters. This knowledge now serves as a powerful asset in her mission to advocate for individuals who have been injured due to negligence.

Melody’s decision to transition from representing corporations to fighting for injured clients was fueled by her passion for helping people navigate the complexities of personal injury law. Her experience in wrongful death, car accidents, slip-and-fall incidents, and premises liability cases gives her a well-rounded perspective and the ability to anticipate and counter the tactics used by insurance companies.

A Strong Foundation in Litigation and Legal Strategy

Melody’s legal journey began during her time at the University of Missouri–Kansas City (UMKC) School of Law, where she honed her litigation skills both in and out of the classroom. As a competitor on the UMKC Mock Trial Team, she gained valuable courtroom experience and developed a strong foundation in trial advocacy.

In addition to her academic achievements, Melody gained hands-on experience through judicial internships that further shaped her understanding of the legal system. She served as a judicial intern for the Honorable Stephen R. Bough in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri, where she gained firsthand exposure to federal court procedures and case management. She also interned for the Honorable Jeffrey L. Bushur in the 16th Circuit of Jackson County, Missouri, where she refined her analytical skills and deepened her understanding of trial preparation.

Melody’s commitment to excellence extended to her role as a staff member for the UMKC Law Review, where she developed her legal writing and editing skills—an essential component of her success in complex litigation matters.

Transition to Plaintiff Advocacy

After gaining extensive experience working on behalf of insurance companies, Melody recognized a calling to make a greater impact by representing individuals whose lives had been disrupted by unforeseen accidents. Her background in insurance defense equips her with the ability to anticipate defense strategies, giving her an advantage when advocating for her clients.

Melody uses her knowledge of how insurance companies evaluate cases to help people who need strong representation. She believes fighting for clients who have been wronged is not just a profession —it’s a mission.

Life Outside the Law

When Melody isn’t working tirelessly for her clients, she enjoys spending quality time with her husband, son, and two beloved dogs. Whether she’s traveling to new destinations, hiking in nature, or attending film festivals, Melody values opportunities to recharge and create lasting memories with her family.

Her passion for exploring different cultures and perspectives translates into her work, where she approaches each case with empathy, dedication, and a commitment to achieving the best possible outcomes for her clients.

A Passion for Justice, A Commitment to Clients

Melody’s personal and professional experiences have shaped her into an attorney who is not only skilled in the nuances of personal injury law but also deeply invested in her clients’ well-being. She believes in treating every client with compassion and respect, ensuring that they feel empowered and informed throughout the legal process.
