attorneys.name: Alan Holcomb
attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Injury Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Alan Holcomb is a Partner at TorHoerman Law and brings over a decade of experience handling catastrophic injury cases to the team. Widely recognized for his legal advocacy and broad experience as a trial lawyer, Alan has handled cases in more than 20 states nationwide. Alan works on cases ranging from products liability, severe burn injuries, wrongful death, chemical exposure, car accidents, lung disease, negligent security, and more. He puts his diverse expertise to work for his clients every day, dedicating his life to representing the people.

Professional Career

After earning his undergraduate degree from the University of Georgia, Alan received his juris doctorate from Emory University School of Law. Before forming his previous firm (Turnbull, Holcomb & Moak), Alan was an equity partner at one of the top insurance defense firms in the country. There, he represented some of the largest companies in the world and acted as national coordinating counsel for a large chemical/flavor manufacturer. This experience taught Alan that he wanted to help equalize the power imbalance between well-funded corporations and consumers — leading him to a career fighting for the people as a plaintiff’s attorney. Licensed to practice law in Georgia, California, Mississippi, and Ohio — Alan is determined to hold major corporations accountable. He relentlessly pursues justice, passionately advocating for his clients every step of the way.

Notable Cases & Results

Failure to Warn: Alan served as co-counsel with THL in a trial against Abbott Laboratories regarding the use of baby formula and premature infants, achieving a landmark $495 million verdict.

Industrial Accident: Alan served as co-counsel for a military veteran who died in an industrial accident in North Georgia. Alan helped the family obtain a significant confidential settlement.

Premises Liability: Alan represented a young child who had a near drowning at a water park in North Georgia, negotiating a policy limits settlement of $16 million for the child and his family.

Products Liability: Alan represented the family of a deceased mother in an automotive products liability case, which settled on the eve of trial for a total of more than $15 million.

Negligent Security: Alan represented the family of a young man murdered at an apartment complex in Las Vegas, Nevada, securing a settlement of $12.7 million.

Negligent Security: Alan obtained a policy limits settlement of $6 million on behalf of the family of a young man murdered at an apartment complex in Las Vegas, Nevada.

Toxic Exposure: Alan and fellow partner Jake Plattenberger successfully represented a former flavoring industry worker in a bellwether trial in Warren County, Ohio. The jury made findings of intentional wrongdoing, then awarded compensatory and punitive damages of $4.4 million and ordered the company to pay the worker’s attorney’s fees.

Medical Malpractice: Alan settled a medical malpractice case at an addiction treatment facility for $4.25 million.

Personal Life

Alan lives in Atlanta, Georgia with his wife and two children. In his spare time, Alan enjoys watching his kids’ youth sports, and cheering on the Georgia Bulldogs, Atlanta, Braves, and New Orleans Saints.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Columbia, MO
attorneys.bio:
Michael S. Holder has had the privilege of representing individuals and families for more than 18 years to include jury trials in cases involving personal injury, property damage, premises liability, medical malpractice and felony criminal defense. He has assisted clients in recovering millions in settlements and verdicts. He has never represented insurance companies.

Michael S. Holder is experienced in assisting his clients during the most difficult of times when decisions must be made regarding financial concerns, insurance claims, medical bills, lost wages and compromised employment. He has made a commitment to helping his clients recover for losses and damages caused by the negligent and wrongful acts of others. If you have recently been injured or lost a loved one as a result of the negligence or wrongful acts of others, please contact Michael S. Holder by phone or email to schedule a free consultation.

Michael S. Holder has the experience needed to properly investigate, prepare and present to a jury the most serious of cases. At a time when individuals and families are facing groups of representatives and experts paid for by national and international corporations, Michael S. Holder has the further advantage of seasoned law partners, trained staff and a full time investigator, allowing the clients of Holder Susan Slusher the benefits of a team approach in advancing their claims to a successful resolution, whether by settlement or jury verdict. If your claim needs the benefit of prompt investigation and evidence preservation, please call Michael S. Holder, by phone or email, to schedule a free appointment.

Michael S. Holder received his undergraduate business administration and MBA degrees from the University of Missouri before enrolling and graduating from the University of Missouri Law School in 1991. His litigation practice concentrates on serious personal injury, wrongful death, medical malpractice, consumer fraud and criminal defense. He is a member of the American Association for Justice (AAJ) and the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys (MATA). He is licensed to practice in both state and federal courts.

attorneys.name: William K. Holland
attorneys.practice_type: Car Accidents Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
A native of St. Louis, Bill received his undergraduate and law degree from the University of Missouri. He has fought hard for personal injury victims for 30 years, spending many a wakeless night worried about his clients and thinking of new and creative ways to litigate their cases. Bill is passionate about helping his clients receive the best medical care and the best result on their cases, whether by trial or settlement.

In fact, he has successfully collected well over $175 Million for his clients. He has tried 45 cases to verdict and mediated hundreds of cases. Bill has successfully litigated 32 cases that resolved for over $1,000,000.00.

Bill and his clients are regularly featured on local news stations KMOV, KSDK and Fox2News. A recent Civil Rights case Bill handled was featured in The New York Times.

A great settlement only goes so far, Bill strongly believes that some cases require us all to "pay it forward." After an especially sad case against a bar for overserving a patron, Bill began sponsoring a local Mothers Against Drunk Driving event. Bill and his client insisted that the bar provide special training to each of its employees on the anniversary of the death of his client's daughter.

When babysitter neglect caused an infant to suffer a head injury, Bill partnered with St. Louis Children's Hospital and helped sponsor a public service video on child head injuries. In addition to the babysitter's insurance carrier paying its policy limits, Bill and his client insisted that the babysitter perform 100 hours of community service as part of the civil settlement, which is not often done.

Bill and his wife reside in Webster Groves. In his spare time, Bill enjoys rooting on his Missouri Tigers, his son's Northwestern Wildcats and his daughters' TCU Horned Frogs.

attorneys.name: Kirk D. Holman
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Rights Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Kirk D. Holman of Holman Schiavone, LLC, comes from a hard-working New England family with humble beginnings. From the time he was a young boy, he yearned to be an attorney so that he could defend the rights of the underdog and champion worthy causes. He represents clients in Kansas City, Missouri, in cases involving civil rights, constitutional law, discrimination, employment and labor law and sexual harassment.

While in his first year of law school at the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law, Mr. Holman grew interested in employment law after a life-changing event in his family. His father was working in a ditch when the dirt collapsed because of a lack of proper supports. He endured numerous surgeries but was never able to work after the accident. His parents struggled on just his mother's income, and he watched his father grieve the loss of a job that represented 35 years of employment.

As a result of this experience, Mr. Holman realized that he could help others protect their rights. He began clerking for the United States Department of Labor in an effort to learn employment law. He is now admitted to practice law in Missouri, Kansas, the U.S. District Court of the Western District of Missouri, the U.S. District Court of the District of Kansas, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 8th Circuit, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

As a respected speaker in the legal field, Mr. Holman has been asked to speak on numerous topics, such as issues in human resources, the Missouri Human Rights Act and the plaintiff's perspective of corporations. Mr. Holman is considered one of the Top 100 Lawyers Missouri & Kansas “Super Lawyers”, a member of the Top 50 Kansas City “Super Lawyers” and has been named a Missouri & Kansas “Super Lawyer” every year since 2011. Mr. Holman is also a Member of “The National Trial Lawyers Top 100 Trial Lawyers” for the State of Missouri. The Association is a national organization composed of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers from each state. Membership is obtained through special invitation and is extended only to those attorneys who exemplify superior qualifications, leadership, reputation, influence, stature, and profile as trial lawyers, both civil plaintiff and criminal defense. He is rated AV Preeminent® by Martindale-Hubbell. This mark is a significant rating accomplishment - a testament to the fact that his legal peers and the judiciary rank him at the highest level of professional excellence. He has tried to verdict as first chair two verdicts in excess of $10,000,000, one additional verdict in excess of $5,000,000, and four additional verdicts in excess of $1,000,000. In addition to these seven and eight figure verdicts, he has to verdict as first chair thirteen verdicts in excess of $125,000.

He has been a member of both the National Employment Lawyers Association and the Labor and Employment Section of the American Bar Association since 2000.

attorneys.name: Joe D. Holt
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Fulton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Joe D. Holt is retired as of January 1, 2026, but we still appreciate his guidance and strive to continue his legacy of service. Joe D. Holt, a descendent of the Holt family who were settlers of Callaway County in 1819, Joe is a graduate of rural Callaway schools, Fulton High School, Westminster College and the University of Missouri-Columbia School of Law and has a Certificate from the center for Dispute Resolution at MU-C. Admitted to the Bar in 1967, he is a past president of the Callaway Co. Bar Association, and from 1967 to 1982 served as State Representative for Callaway County, being the Majority Floor Leader of the Missouri House of Representatives from 1977 to 1980. He was twice given the Outstanding Legislator award by the St. Louis Globe-Democrat.

He served as Associate Circuit Judge for Callaway County 1998 to 2006, during which time he heard all the Probate matters in Callaway and many in Boone Co. As a Judge in the 13th Circuit, he heard contested Dissolution matters in both counties and numerous other types of cases. He has lectured for the Missouri Judicial College on Dissolution and Probate matters.

Before taking the bench, as a private attorney, he tried cases across Mid-Missouri, and practiced estate planning, probate and real estate law. He was Counsel for Levee and Drainage Districts, water districts and fire districts, as well as for the cities of Mokane, New Bloomfield and Fulton.

Joe has served as President of Serve, Inc., The Kingdom Supper, The Kingdom of Callaway Historical Society, and the Missouri Collation for Alternatives to Incarceration. He is currently on the Board of the Historical Society and a member of the Callaway County Civil War Heritage Board. A 40 year member of the Fulton Breakfast Optimist Club, he has twice been President of the club.

Joe is married to Virginia A. Young, former professor at the University of Missouri-Columbia School of Journalism, and former City Editor of the Columbia Tribune, who is now the Bureau Chief for the St. Louis Post Dispatch in Jefferson City, MO. They live west of Fulton in the Central Community. He has five children, two of whom are officers in the U.S. Army.

Joe's practice is in the area of estate planning, estate management, real estate, domestic relations, and mediation and arbitration.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Outstanding Legislator Award, St. Louis Globe-Democrat

attorneys.name: Montanna M. Hosterman
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Montanna Hosterman always wanted to choose a profession where she could help others and found that through the practice of law, she could help real people solve big problems that affected their daily lives. She has a passion for advocating for those who cannot advocate for themselves, a desire to help others seek justice, a keen interest in legal problem-solving, and a strong desire to uphold the principles of fairness and equality.

As a personal injury lawyer, Montanna’s approach is a focus on client-centered representation, a commitment to thorough investigation and preparation, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to empathize with clients who have suffered harm. Relating to clients with effective communication is paramount to successfully ensuring the client feels supported and that their voice is heard.

She strives to take a complex legal concept and convey that to clients in plain language, ensuring that they fully comprehend their rights and options. Using her compassion and empathetic communication strengthens the lawyer-client relationship and helps to ensure clients feel understood and supported.

Montanna was born in Omaha, Nebraska, and received her Bachelor’s Degree at the University of Nebraska-Kearney, where she played collegiate soccer and obtained a major in criminal justice and a minor in psychology. In 2017, she moved to Kansas City and graduated from law school at the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law in 2020.

She currently serves on the Young Professionals Board for a non-profit organization called Safehome. Safehome’s core purpose is to provide a healing atmosphere where survivors of intimate partner abuse can gain inner strength, explore options, and be empowered to live a life free of abuse. Safehome provides shelter and resources to women and children so they can transition from their previous lives. Her hobbies include playing pickleball, disc golf, and any other outdoor activities.

attorneys.name: David J. Howard Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of David J. Howard
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Town And Country, MO
attorneys.bio:
An experienced trial attorney whose practice focuses on the resolution through trial or negotiated settlements for clients he represents in matters involving divorce, child custody, child support, division of property, modifications of prior decrees, contempt of court and other enforcement, and paternity.

Mission: To zealously represent my clients in their family law matters by collaboratively developing a strategy to best serve my clients' goals and provide my clients with information necessary for them to make informed decisions regarding the issues involved in their case and help them through, what is in most cases, the most difficult period of their life.

The Law Office of David J. Howard provides effective, but sensitive, advocacy to clients in all family law matters in the Greater St. Louis area and neighboring Missouri communities. David J. Howard is a skilled advocate for his clients, both in educating them of the process necessary to reach their goals and the execution of their legal game plan.

He provides skilled, professional representation to clients in all family law matters. David is known for his litigation skills as well as his negotiation skills and is committed to resolving each case in the best interests of his clients.

David likes to work collaboratively with his clients to develop goals, strategies and action plans to best achieve the results his client is seeking. David makes every effort to be “the counselor who cares”. David focuses his practice on family law with emphasis on the dissolution of marriages and all matters that are related to divorces; such as, modifications, enforcement and contempt of court, guardianships, and paternity.

When not practicing law, Jared is heavily involved with his family and in the community. He has continuously served on the Board of Directors for The Child Advocacy Center of Northeast Missouri since 2016, and is involved in other local organizations.

attorneys.name: Stuart P. Huffman
attorneys.firm_name: Whiteaker & Wilson, PC d/b/a Law Office of Stuart P. Huffman
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Springfield, MO
attorneys.bio:
Stuart P. Huffman graduated from Central Missouri State University with a bachelor's in science for Criminal Justice and a minor in psychology in 1997. He then went to the University of Missouri-Kansas City and graduated with a J.D. in 2000. Mr. Huffman, while in law school, was a law clerk for Wyandotte County Circuit Court in 1999 and then Jackson County Associate Court in 2000. While a law clerk, he worked directly with Judges to research legal issues and draft legal pleadings. After graduation, he desired employment where he could have the ability to try cases. After passing the bar exam in 2000, he started employment with the Missouri State Public Defender's office in 2001 at the Springfield Missouri Office. He was assigned to be in the trial division and handled all manner of misdemeanor and felony cases. His responsibilities included but were not limited to handling routine court appearances, filing motions on behalf of clients, client conferences, both in the jail and at his office trying felony and misdemeanor bench and jury trials. While at the Public Defender's office, Mr. Huffman had the opportunity to be the primary attorney for numerous felony cases.

In September of 2002, Mr. Huffman left the Public Defender's office and became an associate at the law firm of Whiteaker & Wilson P.C., located in Springfield Missouri. There, he continued to handle criminal cases ranging from traffic to murder in the first degree but also had the chance to handle civil litigation and worker's compensation cases. Mr. Huffman became a partner in 2008 and continues to operate in that capacity with Richard Davis. Over time, Mr. Huffman's practice changed to where he now handles almost exclusively criminal cases. He practices criminal defense in federal, state, and municipal courts located in Springfield Missouri and the surrounding regions. Mr. Huffman is a member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (NACDL) and the Missouri Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers (MACDL). He is also a member of the National Trial Lawyer's Top 100 Lawyers and the American Society of Legal Advocates.

The Missouri Bar selected Mr. Huffman as a Lon O. Hocker Trial Advocacy Award recipient (2009). His peers have recognized him as a Missouri and Kansas Rising Star in 2011 and 2012 Missouri Superlawyer magazine. He has been ranked in the Top 100 Criminal Defense Attorneys every year since 2013, and in 2023 he was the recipient of the Charles Shaw Trial Advocacy Award. This award is for those who exhibit outstanding trial skills and a passion for trying cases involving the innocent accused.

attorneys.name: Scott Hunter
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Before forming Hunter & Cassidy, LLC, attorney Scott A. Hunter spent his first six years of practice developing his litigation skills as an insurance defense attorney. He concentrated much of his practice on defending tractor-trailer companies and drivers facing claims of property damage, catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death as a result of collisions. His next eleven years were spent focusing on personal injury law and business litigation through Hunter & Nantz, LLC and then Hunter Law Office, LLC.

With this expansive range of litigation experience, Mr. Hunter is deeply committed to providing clients with insightful and sophisticated legal representation. Operating a small law office has allowed Mr. Hunter to give clients the individual attention and close communication they deserve and that larger firms simply don’t have the flexibility or time to offer. He has assisted clients in their cases involving motor vehicle accidents, unsafe property conditions, product liability, nursing home neglect, animal attacks, business disputes and plaintiffs’ insurance litigation.

attorneys.bio:
Omar Husain is a dedicated attorney known for his commitment to community and compassion for clients facing challenging times. Drawn to the legal field as a way to serve others, Omar takes pride in helping clients navigate difficult moments. One of the most rewarding aspects of his career is winning a hard-fought trial, particularly when he’s helped a client overcome anxiety and fear along the way.

Omar’s approach to legal practice is detail-oriented and innovative. He invests time in listening to clients, ensuring their concerns are fully heard so he can develop the most effective strategies for their cases. His patience, passion, and meticulous attention to detail make him a strong advocate who thrives on crafting unique, well-planned strategies for each client.

A Kansas City native, Omar earned his undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Kansas. In addition to his legal career, he co-owns The Workout Kansas City, an outdoor group fitness company. He and his wife are passionate about exploring new coffee shops, and he enjoys playing basketball, powerlifting, and watching the Chiefs

Omar also gives back to his community, serving on the Big Brothers Big Sisters Kansas City JEDI Board, the Mid-America Muslim Cemetery Board, and the Young Professionals Board for the Islamic Center of Johnson County.

attorneys.practice_type: Complex and Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Susan Jarrold joined Edgar Law Firm in 2023. Susan represents clients in a variety of complex commercial disputes. Drawing on her judicial and past litigation experience, Susan is particularly adept at clarifying complicated factual and legal issues to deliver compelling briefs at the trial and appellate levels.

Prior to joining the firm, Susan clerked for the Honorable James P. O’Hara in the United States District Court for the District of Kansas. Susan graduated from the University of Kansas School of Law, and then worked for several years in the litigation group of a national, full-service law firm, where she represented clients in toxic and mass tort actions, products liability actions, and complex business litigation. In law school, Susan was a note and comment editor for the Kansas Law Review and judicial intern for the Honorable Kathryn H. Vratil.

Susan enjoys reading and traveling, and, most of all, spending time with her husband and two daughters.

Race and national origin should have nothing to do with your employability or the loss of your job. At the Employee Rights Law Firm — Law Offices of Mark A. Jess, L.L.C., we aggressively advocate for our clients victimized by race discrimination.

Gender discrimination can take on many forms, involving both men and women. If you suspect that your gender is a factor in your job stability or an existing hostile work environment, you need an aggressive employment law attorney at your side.
The sudden loss of a job is unsettling. Even more unsettling is the realization that your firing was actually a retaliatory discharge. You witnessed and reported an illegal activity.

attorneys.name: Emily Kalla
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in St Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Emily Kalla is an experienced attorney who is proud to represent clients suffering from personal injuries. She knows that the best way to help clients is to truly listen and understand them so she can properly tell their stories.

Emily wholeheartedly believes that no one should be taken advantage of, especially people who are put in situations caused by other people’s negligent actions. She loves taking on big insurance companies that are abusing injured victims and helping clients move forward from their challenging experiences. Her goal is for clients to leave 10x better than before they met her.

After being in St. Louis for over 10 years, Emily has developed a strong rapport with those in the community. Not only does she fight for the rights of her clients, but she also strives to build bridges and pave a path forward for all parties. Working with Emily means clients have access to an experienced and empathetic attorney who is not afraid to take on a fight when it is necessary.

Emily loves The Show Me State and has lived all over Missouri. She grew up in Springfield, attending Truman State in Kirksville for undergrad, and received her law degree from the University of Missouri School of Law in Columbia.

In her free time, Emily loves spending time with her husband, three daughters, and dog. They love exploring St. Louis and embarking on adventures.

attorneys.name: Jill A. Kanatzar
attorneys.practice_type: Nursing Home Abuse and Neglect Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Jill Kanatzar is one of the most respected plaintiff attorneys in the region. Her deep experience in cases related to sexual abuse, child injury and wrongful death, nursing home abuse and medical malpractice spans more than 20 years.

Jill’s entire career has been dedicated to helping people who often cannot help themselves. From small children to disabled adults to our elders, she has stood next to and fought for people’s rights. Jill is respected by attorneys throughout the Midwest, hence why she has been named Prosecutor of the Year by Jackson County and earned the Women’s Justice Award by Missouri Lawyers Weekly.

In addition, Jill was appointed by the Missouri Supreme Court to its Advisory Committee. She has also been appointed special prosecutor by numerous prosecutors' offices across Kansas City area jurisdictions.

Prior to joining the firm, Jill was an assistant prosecuting attorney in Jackson County, Missouri, where she prosecuted felony criminal cases including robberies, burglaries, assaults and homicides. Jill spent the majority of her tenure with the Prosecutor’s Office in the Child Abuse & Sex Crimes Unit. She participated in numerous jury trials including cases of adult sex crimes and crimes perpetrated against children.

Jill entered private practice in 1998 when she joined Stigall, Humphrey, Lucas, Henry & Dollar. She soon began representing families and patients injured by abuse and neglect in nursing homes. Jill was appointed by the Supreme Court of Missouri to serve on the 16th Circuit Bar Ethics Committee. This panel reviews complaints brought against other lawyers to determine whether probable cause exists and if ethical violations have occurred.

Jill earned a bachelor’s degree from Drake University in Des Moines, Iowa, dual majoring in economics and political science. She received her law degree from the University of Notre Dame Law School and obtained her license to practice law in 1994. She holds an active license in Missouri and Kansas, as well as before the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri.

attorneys.name: George E. Kapke
attorneys.practice_type: General Litigation Lawyers in Lee's Summit, MO
attorneys.bio:
George Kapke has been engaged in a broad suburban law practice for over thirty years in the area of business and civil litigation, municipal law and personal injury law.

Mr. Kapke received an undergraduate degree in Economics from William Jewell College in 1966. As the top business/economics major in his class, he was the recipient of the Wall Street Journal's Achievement Award.

In 1969, Mr. Kapke earned his law degree from the University of Missouri School of Law where he was a dean merit scholar. While attending law school, George completed clerkships at the trial firm of Sheridan, Sanders, Millin, Peters, Carr and Sharp, and with the legal department of the Kansas City Southern Railroad.

Mr. Kapke began post-graduate legal practice with the defense litigation firm of Jackson & Sherman and has been an associate and partner with Kapke & Willerth L.L.C., since 1971. George has practiced primarily civil litigation in all state and federal courts of Missouri. He has served individuals, business entities and municipal clients by providing both general legal and litigation needs.

A major focus for Mr. Kapke, beyond the practice of law, has been a dedicated, long-term involvement at all levels of the American, Missouri, and Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Associations. George has served in the House of Delegates of the American Bar Association, the Board of Governors of The Missouri Bar, the Executive Committee of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association, and Chairman of Region IV of the Office of Chief Disciplinary Counsel.

Mr. Kapke is also involved in the local community. He currently serves as Chairman of Hillcrest Ministries Transitional Housing (Mid America) and has served as a member of the Board of Directors for the Independence Regional Health Center and is a member of its Ethics Committee. He is also a deacon and trustee of the First Baptist Church of Independence.

attorneys.name: Mark E. Kelly
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Liberty, MO
attorneys.bio:
Mark’s practice areas include workers’ compensation, Plaintiff’s personal injury, automobile accidents, general product liability, litigation, and construction law. Mark has tried many jury trials in Missouri and Kansas state courts. He regularly appears on behalf of Employees and Employers before the Missouri and Kansas Divisions of Workers’ Compensation. While doing this, he has gained experience appearing before the Missouri Labor and Industrial Relations Commission, Missouri and Kansas Court of Appeals and the Kansas Supreme Court. He has also served as a frequent speaker as an expert on Workers’ Compensation at Continuing Legal Education seminars.

Mark obtained his Bachelor of Science, Business Administration degree from William Jewell College, Missouri in 1982. Thereafter he received his Juris Doctorate in May of 1986 from the University Of Missouri – Kansas City, School of Law, where he made the Dean’s List.

Following his accomplished graduation from UMKC, he was accepted as a member of the Missouri State Bar and then a year later accepted as a member of the Kansas State Bar in 1987. While remaining in those two Associations, he proudly gained legal affiliation with the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association, Kansas Trial Lawyers Association, and the Missouri Association of Trial Lawyers. Mark has also received top honors as a Missouri and Kansas Super Lawyer in 2012, 2011, 2010 and 2009.

Mark is a lifetime Northland resident and currently resides in Kearney with his wife, Lorry, and their five children, Erin, Blaire, Cooper, Elyse and Caroline. He is currently a member of the Kearney, Missouri School Board and is highly recommended by many who work with him.

attorneys.name: Kara Elizabeth Key JD
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Liberty, MO
attorneys.bio:
Kara E. Key, JD is a dedicated and compassionate associate attorney at The Roffmann Law Office, LLC, where she focuses her practice exclusively on family law, including divorce, custody disputes, child support, paternity cases, modifications, adoption, guardianship, domestic violence matters, and grandparents’ rights. Licensed in Missouri, Ms. Key is committed to guiding clients through some of the most challenging times in their lives with a thoughtful and strategic approach. She works to find creative and effective solutions, prioritizing amicable resolutions when possible while remaining a strong advocate in the courtroom when litigation is necessary.

Originally from Texas, Ms. Key earned her law degree in Charleston, South Carolina, where she also gained extensive experience working at a boutique family law firm throughout law school. There, she developed a deep understanding of complex custody issues, asset division, and high-conflict family disputes. Following law school, she practiced in Texas under a supervisory license, assisting clients with all facets of family law litigation, from case strategy and discovery to depositions, mediations, and trial preparation.

Ms. Key’s passion for family law stems from her own personal experience—when her stepfather adopted her and her siblings, she witnessed firsthand the profound impact a dedicated attorney can have on a family's future. This experience shaped her commitment to serving clients with the same level of care, advocacy, and dedication.

Ms. Key relocated to the Kansas City area in 2022, drawn to The Roffmann Law Office, LLC mission of providing high-quality legal representation with a client-centered approach. She is a member of the American Bar Association, the Clay County Bar Association, and the Association of Women Lawyers.

attorneys.name: Laura King Esq.

attorneys.bio:
When you are navigating a difficult domestic matter, having a dedicated advocate by your side can make a meaningful difference. Laura King is a Senior Associate Attorney with Stange Law Firm, serving clients from the firm’s Springfield, Missouri office. She is committed to providing compassionate, thorough, and client-centered representation during challenging times.

She earned her Juris Doctor from the University of Arkansas School of Law, where she was active in competitions and received several honors, including the Robert J. Fussell Outstanding Pro Bono Scholarship Award. Laura holds a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology from Seattle University and an Associate of Arts from South Seattle Community College, earning Dean’s List recognition at both institutions.

Before joining Stange Law Firm, Laura served as the District Defender for the Missouri State Public Defender’s Office in Ava, Missouri. She managed caseloads, maintained organized files, and represented clients from their initial appearance through resolution. She regularly drafted and argued motions, prepared appellate filings, and communicated closely with clients. Her significant trial background gives her the poise and advocacy skills essential in domestic relations matters. attorneys.name: Michael E. Klenov
attorneys.practice_type: Securities Litigation Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Michael E. Klenov is a partner at Korein Tillery's St. Louis office. He is licensed to practice law in Illinois, Missouri, New York, California, and the District of Columbia, as well as numerous federal district and appellate courts. Michael concentrates his practice on complex civil litigation in the areas of ERISA/Pension Funds, Securities, Antitrust, Qui Tam/Whistleblower claims, and Commercial Disputes. He represents individuals, governmental entities, and major companies in high-stakes lawsuits.

Since joining Korein Tillery, Michael has achieved impressive results for both his individual and his business clients. He has been appointed as lead counsel in several nationwide class actions and has negotiated a number of multi-million dollar class settlements. In 2012, Michael was part of the legal team that attained a $105 million dollar settlement in historic environmental litigation on behalf of a large number of municipalities and the country's largest private water provider. Following the settlement, Public Justice named Michael and the rest of the trial team as finalists for their national Trial Lawyer of the Year Award.

Michael currently represents a governmental agency and a major insurance company in securities litigation arising from the collapse of the mortgage-backed securities (“RMBS”) market. That litigation spans over a dozen cases pending in four district courts in the Second, Seventh, Ninth, and Tenth Circuits. Korein Tillery and its co-counsel have already recovered well over a billion dollars for their clients in RMBS litigation. Michael is also the lead attorney in a major ERISA/deferred-compensation lawsuit pending in a district court in the Fourth Circuit.

Michael routinely and successfully briefs novel, complex legal issues in state and federal courts across the country. His written advocacy has yielded a number of significant victories, including the following recent decisions:

§ CMFG Life Ins. Co. v. RBS Sec. Inc., 12-CV-037-WMC, 2013 WL 4483068 (W.D. Wis. Aug. 19, 2013) (successfully defeated motion to dismiss in securities case asserting novel contractual rescission theory of relief);

§ Bond v. Marriott Int'l, Inc., 10-CV-1256-RWT, 2013 WL 4829263 (D. Md. Aug. 9, 2013) (won summary judgment on defendants’ affirmative defenses of the statute-of-limitations and laches);

§ England v. Marriott Int'l, Inc., 764 F. Supp. 2d 761 (D. Md. 2011) (successfully defeated motion to dismiss in novel ERISA lawsuit challenging the legality of a purportedly exempt pension plan);

§ City of Greenville, Ill. v. Syngenta Crop Prot., Inc., 830 F. Supp. 2d 550 (S.D. Ill. 2011) (successfully obtained personal jurisdiction over Swiss holding company despite previous federal decision to the contrary);

§ City of Greenville, Ill. v. Syngenta Crop Prot., Inc., 756 F. Supp. 2d 1001 (S.D. Ill. 2010) (successfully defeated motion to dismiss challenging municipalities' standing to seek relief in novel environmental class action).

Michael received his B.A. in Economics, International Studies, and Business Institutions from Northwestern University. While completing his undergraduate degree, Michael spent a year studying economics and philosophy at the London School of Economics and Political Science. Subsequently, Michael attended the Washington University School of Law where he received a Scholar-in-Law scholarship. He graduated Magna Cum Laude, Order of the Coif, and received a number of academic awards, including the Charles Wendell Carnahan Prize. While in law school, Michael served as a Senior Editor of the Washington University Law Review, where he also published his Note. See Preemption and Removal: Watson Shuts the Federal Officer Backdoor to the Federal Courthouse, Conceals Familiar Motive, 86 Wash. U. L. Rev. 1455 (2009) (cited by Wright & Miller, 14C Fed. Prac. & Proc. § 3726 (4th ed.)). During his third year of law school, Michael clerked for the Honorable David R. Herndon, Chief Judge of the United States District Court for the Southern District of Illinois.

Michael was born in St. Petersburg, Russia and immigrated to the United States when he was ten years old. He is still conversant in Russian, as well as Spanish. He attended high school at John Burroughs School in St. Louis, which he largely credits for laying the groundwork for his personal and professional development, as well as for introducing him to his life-long friends.

attorneys.name: Frederick B. Kruger
attorneys.practice_type: Transactional Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
During the last 25 of his 30 years of legal practice, Fred Kruger served as in-house counsel for Anheuser-Busch Companies, Inc. From 2000 through 2008 he was Senior Associate General Counsel and head of the Corporate and Commercial Section of the legal department. In that capacity, he was responsible for advising the company in the execution of its many diverse business transactions, ranging from mergers and acquisitions to procurement, marketing and promotional activities, as well as assisting the company with related regulatory, compliance and corporate governance concerns. As head of this Section he supervised a group that grew to twelve attorneys, four paralegals, one contract analyst and five legal assistants.

In this role, Mr. Kruger was responsible for advising and assisting the company in planning, negotiating, documenting and completing a variety of mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures and other transactions. He was the architect of the company's highly successful investment program under which the company was able to acquire a shared ownership interest in many wholesalers which otherwise remained under independent ownership and management. Mr. Kruger and his Section handled a wide variety of legal problems due to the highly vertical integration of the company and its diversification into other industries, including not only traditional brewing but also agricultural production, can and bottle container manufacturing, production of other food, beverage and snack products, and operation of entertainment theme parks. While at Anheuser-Busch some of Mr. Kruger's accomplishments included directing the legal work for transactions involving hundreds of millions of dollars in many of these industries for locations throughout the United States and other parts of the world; managing the professional legal staff with an emphasis on individual growth, accomplishment and personal development; creating and implementing a management system which ensured prompt and appropriate review of the company's legal commitments and the integrity of contracts executed by it; assisting senior management with preparation of and acceptance by the company's wholesaler network of a restated national distribution agreement; assisting with the transformation and growth of the company's metal container manufacturing business from a position as a small, captive supplier into a major industry competitor which supplied many soft drink producers and other outside customers; and advising management on various corporate secretary functions, other related regulatory matters including Sarbanes Oxley compliance and corporate governance practices.

Mr. Kruger is also an Adjunct Professor at Washington University School of Law, and teaches a class on drafting commercial contracts.

"The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements."

attorneys.name: Alex Lamb
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Saint Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Alex Lamb always knew he wanted to help people but wasn’t exactly sure how to best pursue his aspirations. Alex used to spend a lot of time at Cardinal Glennon Children’s Hospital when his dad was the director of the Respiratory Care department, and he admired the medical professionals that helped children and their families. He used to visit the sick children and help however he could, including being a junior counselor at a summer camp for asthmatic kids. Alex also had a passion for English literature and composition, interpreting and presenting different points of view, advocating for those who were unable or unwilling to do so for themselves, helping people tell their stories, and seeking justice in tough circumstances. His parents instilled many lifelong values in him, including standing up for other people.

Alex attended Saint Louis University High School, a private Jesuit college preparatory school that aspire to be “men for others”. After graduation from Saint Louis University High School, Alex attended Truman State University, on a full academic scholarship, and initially decided to pursue a degree in Biology Pre-Med. Although he admired medical professionals and the many ways they help people, Alex desired to not only help, but also advocate for others, and so he reconsidered his path. After taking some time away from school, he re-enrolled in college and switched his major to English Pre-Law. Shortly after his return to school, Alex was in a multiple car accident on Interstate 70, which left the driver directly in front of him deceased. Fortunately, Alex found an advocate to help him endure the numerous medical treatments, anxiety, and costs that resulted from the crash. It was during this tough time that Alex began to truly appreciate the importance of personal injury attorneys that fight for crash victims and help them try to get their life back to normal.

After graduating from Truman State University, Alex attended The University of Missouri-Columbia Law School and studied for one semester in Los Angeles at Loyola Law School. He passed the bar examination immediately after graduating from Mizzou and began practicing with a small general practice firm in St. Charles County, Missouri. After a couple of years, Alex started his own law firm, where he handled a variety of legal matters throughout St. Charles County, St. Louis County, Lincoln County, Warren County, Franklin County, and St. Louis City. He met Shaun Lieser in 2016 and quickly realized the Lieser Law Firm, LLC shared his drive and desire to help others. He joined the Lieser Law Firm, LLC in December of 2016.

Because of his personal experience of being a crash victim himself, Alex can directly relate to his clients that are experiencing the physical, emotional, and financial consequences of being personally injured. Alex combines his life experiences, educational knowledge, and core values into passionate representation of his clients. When he is not helping others, Alex enjoys making beer and wine, listening to old vinyl records, spending time with family and friends, and supporting St. Louis sports teams.

attorneys.name: Shelbie Langford
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Shelbie Langford is an attorney at DM Injury Law who is unafraid to stand up for her clients’ rights and take on the burden of a workers’ compensation case. She takes pride in her ability to analyze complex issues and navigate her clients through the complex legal process.

After giving her first legal argument in front of a federal judge in law school, as a new lawyer Shelbie is confident in taking on any situation her clients are facing. Shelbie values giving honest advice and guidance throughout the process to paint a clear picture for her clients. The workers’ compensation process can be challenging, and Shelbie hopes to be a guiding light for her clients.

Shelbie grew up in Kearney, Missouri. There, her father and grandfather worked on the line for Ford Motor Company. She saw her father attempt to weave through the complicated workers’ compensation process. This inspires her today as she strives to make the workers’ compensation process as easy as possible for all her clients.

In her free time, Shelbie stays active by participating in 5Ks, soccer clubs, and yoga. She loves spending time with her Dutch Shepherd/Greyhound, her boyfriend, friends, and family. Shelbie volunteers all over Kansas City at local dog shelters and youth organizations.

His approach is defined by clear communication and aggressive advocacy, making sure his clients understand every step of the process and feel confident that their needs are being met.

Throughout his career, Aaron has handled depositions, trials, and appellate briefs, but the most rewarding moments come when clients express gratitude for his support and representation. He believes in actively listening to his clients’ concerns and providing honest, realistic advice. While he may have many clients, he understands that each client only has one attorney and strives to provide them with the attention and dedication they deserve.

Aaron grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, but has strong family roots in St. Louis. A passionate fan of St. Louis sports, he cheers for the Cardinals, Blues, Battlehawks, and St. Louis City SC. When he’s not fighting for his clients, Aaron enjoys spending time with his wife, daughter, son, and dog, especially at sporting events and local parks.

attorneys.name: Michael A. Lawder
attorneys.practice_type: Trucking Law Lawyers in Saint Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Since beginning his practice over thirty years ago, Mr. Lawder has devoted a large part of his practice to motor carrier defense throughout the United States with a particular emphasis on allegations directed specifically against the trucking company as well as its drivers. He has tried numerous truck cases to verdict in the federal and state courts in both Eastern Missouri and Southern Illinois. Mike is familiar with the many different court systems and understands the nature of the juries in many locations. He has tried over 50 cases to verdict.

Mike also has represented over 100 different trucking companies in accident litigation and understands the differences and challenges in defending a trucking company and driver before a potentially hostile jury. He regularly attends continuing legal education in this field presented by the ABA, Defense Research Institute (DRI), and the American Trucking Association.

Mr. Lawder has presented trucking topics at to various groups and has presented many in-house seminars to trucking companies and trucking insurers. Mike also has successfully defended trucking companies in various types of cargo claim litigation. He has developed a rapid response team to evaluate immediately a trucking company's exposure in a significant accident.

Mr. Lawder also maintains a general litigation practice that includes prosecution and defense of foreclosure matters, lender liability claims, title insurance matters, loan collections, lien priority issues, and consumer bankruptcy.

attorneys.name: Elizabeth S. Lenivy
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Liz is a dedicated advocate for those who have been injured due to medical malpractice, dangerous products, and motor vehicle accidents. With a passion for plaintiffs’ advocacy, Liz gained valuable experience as a law student while clerking at Simon Law. After graduating, she worked as an associate at a local firm, where she focused on insurance defense in product liability, premises liability, and personal injury claims. This experience provided her with unique insight into the strategies employed by defendants and insurance companies.

Driven by personal experiences of loss and injustice, Liz is committed to fighting for her clients and telling their stories to help them achieve the justice they deserve. Since joining Simon Law in 2016, Liz has successfully tried multiple cases to verdict, including complex medical malpractice and product liability cases. She has also argued before the Missouri Court of Appeals and submitted briefs to the Missouri Supreme Court and Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals. Liz actively participates in the St. Louis legal community, holding leadership positions on various boards and bar organizations, and providing pro bono services.

Outside of her legal practice, Liz is involved in the Korean American community of St. Louis as a board member of the Gateway Korea Foundation. As a first-generation American and the first attorney in her family, she takes pride in using her legal skills to celebrate her Korean and American heritage. In her free time, Liz enjoys spending time with her husband Steve, exploring St. Louis’ vibrant food scene, and cheering on CITY SC.

attorneys.name: Matthew D. Leonard
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Hillsboro, MO
attorneys.bio:
Matt Leonard joined the law firm of Roberts, Wooten, and Zimmer in 2023. He is an experienced attorney who has been practicing law in Missouri for over 20 years. Matt focuses his work primarily in the areas of Workers' Compensation, Personal Injury, Criminal Defense, and Traffic Law.

Matt grew up in St. Peters, MO and graduated from Francis Howell North High School. He attended the University of Missouri in Columbia where he graduated cum laude with a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration with an emphasis in Finance and Banking. Matt went on to earn his law degree from the University of Missouri Columbia in 2001.

Matt was admitted to the Missouri Bar in 2001 and to the Illinois Bar in 2015. Following graduation from law school Matt worked as an Assistant Public Defender for the Missouri Public Defender's office in Springfield, MO where he represented clients in misdemeanor and felony cases. He then returned to the St. Louis area where he worked for three different workers' compensation defense firms over the next twenty years representing employers and insurers in workers' compensation claims. During that time Matt represented clients before the Missouri Division of Workers' Compensation, Missouri Labor and Industrial Relations Commission, Missouri Court of Appeals, and Missouri Supreme Court. He has also represented clients before the Illinois Workers' Compensation Commission.

Matt enjoys sports, reading, traveling and spending time with his wife, daughter and two dogs.

attorneys.name: Matthew B. Leppert
attorneys.practice_type: Employee Benefits Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Matt Leppert focuses on Employee Benefits Law in the context of Taft-Hartley, multiemployer jointly administered welfare and retirement plans and training funds. For over 20 years, Matt has represented benefit plans, fiduciaries, plan sponsors, unions, and individuals in matters arising under ERISA and the Internal Revenue Code including obtaining favorable determination letters, drafting and amending plan documents and summary plan descriptions, correcting plan document and administration errors, resolving plan funding issues, coordinating responses to Department of Labor, IRS, and PBGC compliance investigations and audits, negotiating service provider agreements, and negotiating and implementing plan mergers and terminations. Matt has also represented insolvent retirement plans and retirement plans that have withdrawal liability or have experienced a mass withdrawal.

Matt has presented on topics such as monitoring plan service providers, the Affordable Care Act, lifetime participation in retirement plans, HIPAA/HITECH, SECURE 2.0, and ERISA contribution/audit enforcement and withdrawal liability. Matt is a member of the American Bar Association's Section of Labor and Employment Law Employee Benefits Committee, the International Foundation of Employee Benefit Plans, and the AFL-CIO, Union Lawyers Alliance. Matt is a Chapter Editor for the Employee Benefits Law treatise and has also authored sections on document retention for the Workplace Data Law and Litigation treatise. Matt has also been active in the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis (BAMSL) and previously served as BAMSL’s Labor and Employment Law Section Chair. Matt received his law degree and Certificate in Health Law Studies from St. Louis University School of Law in 2003 where he served as Senior Articles Editor for the Journal of Health Law and President of the Public Interest Law Group. Matt is admitted to the bar in Missouri and Illinois, the Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals, and the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern and Western Districts of Missouri and the Southern District of Illinois.

attorneys.name: Joseph L. Leritz (In Memoriam)
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Law Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Joseph L. Leritz, esteemed senior partner of the firm, passed away on February 19, 2026.

Joe dedicated over 70 years to the practice of law in St. Louis, building a legacy defined by excellence, integrity, and service. A highly respected trial and appellate attorney, he appeared before courts at every level, including the United States Supreme Court, and represented thousands of clients throughout his distinguished career.

He concentrated his practice in fire insurance, subrogation, insurance coverage litigation, and commercial litigation, and also served as a mediator and arbitrator. He was certified as a neutral by the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri.

Joe was a proud graduate of St. Louis University High School and Saint Louis University School of Law, and served as an intelligence officer in the United States Army in Frankfurt, Germany.

Beyond his legal work, Joe was deeply committed to service, including his long-standing representation of Birthright of St. Louis, for which he and his wife Francine were honored with the Monsignor Hartnett Award.

He was an active member of the Missouri Bar Association, the Bar Association of Metropolitan St. Louis, and the Association of Defense Counsel, where he served as President from 1969 to 1970. He earned Martindale-Hubbell’s AV Peer Review Rating and was listed in the Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers. He also co-authored Property and Business Liability - Commercial General Liability Coverage for Missouri CLE.

Joe is survived by his beloved wife of nearly 70 years, Francine, along with his children, grandchildren, great-grandchildren, and extended family.

His legacy will continue to live on through the firm, his family, and the many lives he impacted throughout his career.

attorneys.name: Shaun Lieser
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Saint Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Shaun Lieser knew from an early age that he wanted to practice law, but his motivation became personal after the sudden loss of his mother in 2007. It was shortly after this tragedy when he founded the Lieser Law Firm. He has since dedicated his practice to assisting individuals and families who have suffered tremendous loss due to the wrongful conduct of others.

“My success is driven by my life experiences, which have provided me with great empathy and passion for my clients. My personal understanding of your pain enables me to value what has been lost and successfully share your stories with an insurance company, judge, or jury.”

From humble beginnings in a hard-working Union family, Shaun attended St. Louis University High School where he played on several sports teams. As a standout athlete, Shaun received a soccer scholarship to Vanderbilt University in Nashville, Tennessee, where he earned his bachelor’s degree in communications. After graduation, Shaun returned home to attend St. Louis University School of Law.

When he finished law school and obtained his law license, Shaun was honored to accept a position at his trial advocacy professor’s personal injury law firm in Collinsville, Illinois. With a sincere passion for helping others in his home community, he went on to found Lieser Law Firm with offices in St. Louis, Missouri and Belleville, Illinois.

Shaun cares most about his family, his clients, and his community. His commitment to serving others extends beyond his career as a lawyer and drives his involvement as a citizen. As a lifelong athlete, Shaun enjoys participating in charity events such as the Tough Mudder, an endurance race to benefit the Wounded Warrior Project to aid injured military service members. He is also an active supporter of the Disabled Athlete Sports Association.

He has since dedicated his practice to assisting individuals and families who have suffered tremendous loss due to the wrongful conduct of others.

“My success is driven by my life experiences, which have provided me with great empathy and passion for my clients. My personal understanding of your pain enables me to value what has been lost and successfully share your stories with an insurance company, judge, or jury.”

From humble beginnings in a hard-working Union family, Shaun attended St. Louis University High School where he played on several sports teams. As a standout athlete, Shaun received a soccer scholarship to Vanderbilt University in Nashville, Tennessee, where he earned his bachelor’s degree in communications. After graduation, Shaun returned home to attend St. Louis University School of Law.

When he finished law school and obtained his law license, Shaun was honored to accept a position at his trial advocacy professor’s personal injury law firm in Collinsville, Illinois. With a sincere passion for helping others in his home community, he went on to found Lieser Law Firm with offices in St. Louis, Missouri and Belleville, Illinois.

Shaun cares most about his family, his clients, and his community. His commitment to serving others extends beyond his career as a lawyer and drives his involvement as a citizen. As a lifelong athlete, Shaun enjoys participating in charity events such as the Tough Mudder, an endurance race to benefit the Wounded Warrior Project to aid injured military service members. He is also an active supporter of the Disabled Athlete Sports Association.

attorneys.name: Ryan Loehr
attorneys.practice_type: Complex and Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Ryan Loehr is a trial lawyer who specializes in complex civil litigation, representing individuals and businesses who’ve been financially damaged by the acts of negligent or fraudulent companies. Ryan’s strengths include cutting through the obstacles that sometimes drag litigation down, instead focusing on the end goal using an “A to Z” litigation strategy.

Ryan’s knowledge of litigation came by way of working nearly 4 years as a civil defense attorney, where he represented businesses against claims brought by plaintiffs throughout the country. This experience taught Ryan what matters in the litigation process moves the case forward, and what areas deserve time and expense. Ryan has tried cases in front of juries, landing some of the top Missouri verdicts for his clients. Ryan has also been named a “Rising Star” by SuperLawyers.

Ryan went to law school after a 10-year career in marketing and advertising. Ryan values this “real world” experience, and knows the realities of how businesses operate. After law school, Ryan clerked for a Judge on the Kansas Court of Appeals, where he examined cases on appeal and researched where attorneys went wrong at trial, be it missed arguments or insufficient evidence. Prior to coming to the Edgar Law Firm, Ryan worked at a firm specializing in mass-tort, multi-district litigation, where Ryan helped manage the firm’s involvement, representing thousands of clients in several national litigations.

Ryan is the former president of the Morningside Neighborhood Association. Ryan spends his free time with his wife, Brook, and with his rescue dog, Satchmo. Ryan is also an avid mountain biker, and volunteers building mountain bike trails in and around the Kansas City area.

attorneys.name: Scott C. Long
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
General contractors, subcontractors and other members of the construction trade rely on Scott Long to resolve conflicts and keep projects going. Scott applies nearly three decades of experience in construction law to provide practical counsel grounded in knowledge of the industry.

Scott understands that dispute resolution in construction often requires preserving a working relationship so the project can stay on track – or so the parties can work together in the future. He works to solve problems outside the courtroom when possible. In one recent matter, he helped a contractor whose project was delayed by the coronavirus negotiate revised terms with the owner.

When litigation is unavoidable, clients benefit from Scott’s extensive experience trying and arbitrating cases and arguing appeals. He has tried more than 50 cases to verdict on behalf of both plaintiffs and defendants in federal and state courts. He has litigated a wide variety of commercial cost recovery, bonding, construction, real estate and business dispute cases.

Scott also works to protect the interests of homeowners’ associations. Working on behalf of condominium homeowners’ associations, Scott has recovered millions of dollars needed to repair construction defects.

Scott is adept at interpreting AIA and AGC contract boilerplates, negotiating their terms, and helping clients avoid potential pitfalls within them. A Fellow in the Construction Lawyers Society of America, he frequently speaks on legal topics affecting the industry.

He has been recognized by the Kansas City Business Journal’s “Best of the Bar,” Super Lawyers, and Best Lawyers in America, among others.

Scott is a proud father of three children. He enjoys running and adventure travel. He spends as much time as he can in the mountains of Colorado.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Caroline Lowe is an attorney dedicated to standing up for individuals during some of the most challenging times in their lives. Inspired by a strong sense of justice and a desire to give others a voice, Caroline chose the practice of law to advocate for those in need and ensure they receive the respect, support, and compensation they deserve. She specializes in car accidents, premises liability, and animal bites.

Caroline approaches each case with care, responsibility, and a client-focused mindset. She believes in listening closely, offering transparent guidance, and tailoring her advocacy to meet each client’s unique needs.

Her reliability, attention to detail, and tireless work ethic make her a trusted advocate in the field of personal injury law. As a Kansas native, Caroline also brings a personal understanding of the community she serves, making her work especially meaningful.

Caroline grew up in Overland Park, Kansas, and pursued the Legal Education Accelerated Degree program at the University of Kansas, where she earned both her Bachelor of Arts and Juris Doctor in just six years. Outside of her practice, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, walking her two dogs, and cheering on the Kansas City Chiefs. She also volunteers at Great Plains SPCA, reflecting her passion for giving animals a second chance at life.

attorneys.name: Matthew D. Lowe
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Clinton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Matt Lowe graduated from Clinton High School in May of 1995 and continued his education, preparatory and legal, at the University of Missouri-Kansas City. Mr. Lowe received his Bachelor of Science in Political Science in 1999, and his J.D. in 2002. Matt was admitted to the Missouri Bar in 2003, and began working at the Law Offices of Dull & Lowe, LLC. He is now associated with Johns, Mitchell, Duncan, & Lowe where he is listed as Of Counsel.

A majority of Mr. Lowe’s practice was dedicated to the litigation of criminal defense cases. He has represented hundreds of clients on various criminal cases ranging from traffic violations to murder charges. This representation focused on defending individuals who have been accused of alcohol related driving offenses. Mr. Lowe has successfully defended citizens arrested for driving while intoxicated in both their criminal case and in the driver’s license sanction actions brought against them by the Director of Revenue. He has tried hundreds of DWI cases to judges, juries, and administrative hearing officers.

Mr. Lowe is certified in the administration of standardized field sobriety tests and has completed the 24 hour NHTSA DWI Detection and Standardized Field Sobriety Testing Course. He has been certified on the operation of various breath testing instruments and has extensive experience on cross examining law enforcement officers and expert witnesses on breath testing devices. He travelled to Mansfield Ohio in 2011 where he received several days of training on the DataMaster breathalyzer machine. In 2015 he successfully completed a class on the theory and practice of forensic chromatography at Axion Analytical Laboratories, Inc. in Chicago, Illinois.

Mr. Lowe has been featured on the faculty for multiple seminars including Missouri’s largest DWI Defense programs for attorneys. He was included among the National Trial Lawyers Top 100 trial attorneys in the State of Missouri. He has also been included in the National Trial Lawyers Top 40 under 40. Mr. Lowe is a Lifetime Member of the Missouri Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. He served on the Board of Directors for the Missouri Criminal Defense Lawyers from 2010 to 2016.

In addition to criminal law, Mr. Lowe also has experience in other areas of the law, including domestic litigation and personal injury litigation. He has participated in cases totaling more than $20,000,000 in settlement and jury awards. In 2016, Mr. Lowe left the full time practice of law to become Vice President of Champion Brands, LLC in Clinton, Missouri. He remains available to provide advice and direction to clients through the firm of Johns Mitchell Duncan & Lowe.

attorneys.name: David M. Lurie
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Growing up in Springfield, Missouri , and being the son of a physician, left David with the inner drive to help and serve people.

Upon graduating in 1977 from the University of Missouri at Kansas City Law School , David made a commitment to take a holistic approach while effectively protecting clients' rights.

In his 45+ years experience as a criminal and traffic defense attorney, serving thousands of clients, only a handful of cases required trials. A majority of David's cases are able to be favorably plead out because of his individualized & comprehensive approach in helping his clients solve their legal problems. David's thoroughness with each client makes him a very effective criminal and traffic defense lawyer.

David's training, experience and fundamental belief in approaching each case with total honesty to the client, and attention to each detail with each individual case, has made David one of the finest negotiators in his field, enabling many of his clients to come through their legal ordeals with the least amount possible of negative impact on their records and lives.

In addition to David's extensive 45+ years of legal experience and training, he has 25+ years of specialized training in leadership and development - making his communication skills unsurpassed when working toward a favorable disposition with prosecutors and judges.

attorneys.name: John M. Lynch
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of John M. Lynch, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Federal Criminal Law Lawyers in Clayton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Attorney John M. Lynch has over eight years of law enforcement experience as a police investigator and federal drug task force agent. Paired with his legal degree from St. Louis University School of Law, Mr. Lynch provides a unique and candid perspective for people charged with a full range of criminal activities. His practice includes federal criminal defense, DUI/DWI defense, drug possession defense and white-collar crime defense.

Attorney Lynch was invited to speak at Washington University regarding gun ownership rights and the associated legislative process. As a repeat lecturer, Attorney Lynch's keen insight into the Second Amendment and how it is applied by states was a particular point of discussion for students studying ways to limit incidents of domestic abuse. He has lectured on topics such as constitutional law - search and seizure, community policing, federal and state drug laws, and methamphetamine production. Working in various investigations, he has partnered with local media in presenting requested investigative reports. Additionally, Mr. Lynch enjoys his volunteer work, which recently includes corporate sponsorship of a golf tournament to benefit a charitable organization providing assistance to disabled children in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

Mr. Lynch concentrates in the areas of Federal and State Criminal Defense, Misdemeanor, Traffic/DWI and General Civil Litigation. With over eight (8) years of law enforcement experience as a police investigator and federal drug task force agent, Mr. Lynch provides a unique and candid legal perspective for those charged with the full myriad of criminal activities; from the inherently complex felony such as a white collar offense or criminal drug conspiracy, to routine traffic offenses and other ordinance violations. Mr. Lynch has lectured on such topics as Constitutional Law- Search and Seizure; Community Policing; Federal and State Drug Laws; and Methamphetamine Production. In conjunction with various investigations, he has also worked closely with local media in presenting requested investigative reports. Mr. Lynch's law enforcement experience has also allowed him to expand into other areas of law where he strives to provide only professional and effective legal representation.

attorneys.name: Rhona S. Lyons
attorneys.practice_type: Employee Benefits Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Rhona Lyons focuses on Employee Benefits Law in the context of Taft-Hartley, multiemployer jointly administered welfare and retirement plans. Rhona advises boards of Trustees on changes in the law, compliance with laws and regulations, and issues of administration and represents boards in judicial and administrative proceedings. Rhona is active in the American Bar Association’s Section of Labor and Employment Law Employee Benefits Committee. She was inducted into the American College of Employee Benefits Counsel in September 2016. Rhona received her law degree from the University of Missouri-Columbia in 1986 (Order of the Coif) where she was on the Law Review and published an article on environmental law. Rhona received her LLM in tax law from Washington University School of Law in 1999.

Out of the office, Rhona is a member of the Workers' Rights Board of Jobs with Justice St. Louis, on the Advisory Council for Bread and Roses, on the board of Jews United for Justice, and is a member of the Jewish Community Relations Council. She is licensed to practice law in Missouri, Illinois and Ohio (inactive status) and is admitted to practice in the United States District Courts for the Eastern District of Missouri, the Southern District of Illinois and the Central District of Illinois as well as the Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Andrew S. Lyskowski Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Camdenton, MO
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Lyskowski is a native of mid-Missouri, raised in Jefferson City. Andrew attended Truman State University, where he earned his Bachelor of Arts degree in English while maintaining an active role on campus, and began fostering his interest in law. Upon graduating, Andrew began law school at the University of Missouri, Columbia. During his time there, he was elected President of the Student Chapter of the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, and was honored to represent the University of Missouri School of Law in the American Bar Association's regional negotiation competition.

After graduating, Andrew spent a legislative session in Jefferson City at the Capitol working for Senate Research. After taking and passing the Missouri Bar Exam, Andrew accepted the position of an Assistant Attorney General learning and working exclusively in the area of workers' compensation in defending the State's Second Injury Fund.

An attorney at Bergmanis Law Firm, L.L.C., since 2007, Andrew focuses his ever expanding practice on workers' compensation and personal injury.

When he is not working, Andrew can be found outdoors.

Our attorneys represent plaintiffs in personal injury and workers' compensation cases. We represent people charged with a crime in misdemeanor and felony cases. We provide aggressive representation for all of our clients with the goal of obtaining the best possible result in each case.

attorneys.name: Matthew W. Lytle
attorneys.practice_type: Banking Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, MO
attorneys.bio:
Throughout his practice, Matt has represented clients ranging from individuals to privately held and publicly traded corporations in various state and federal courts nationwide, and in arbitrations with the AAA and the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA). Matt’s experience covers all phases of the litigation process including case strategy, pre-trial briefing and motion practice, depositions and discovery, dispositive motion practice, trial preparation, trial, and appeals.

Matt’s representative litigation experience includes representing both plaintiffs and defendants in disputes involving claims for fraud, breach of fiduciary duty, breach of trust, breach of contract, and civil RICO, as well as consumer class action claims.

In addition to litigation, Matt has experience in the area of white collar defense and investigations, and has represented clients in investigations by various federal agencies including the CFTC and the USDA.

Matt was named a 2011 and 2012 Rising Star by Missouri & Kansas Super Lawyers, a distinction reserved for less than three percent of the best lawyers in the state age 40 or under. Matt was also named to the 2012 BTI Client Service All-Stars, a select group of only 272 lawyers nationwide who are chosen solely on unprompted, unequivocal recommendations by corporate counsel for their understanding of business issues, innovative approaches to legal services, and commitment to client needs.

Prior to becoming an attorney, Matt served on the staff of a Member of the United States House of Representatives and worked as a licensed stock broker.

Matt is a native of Colorado and spent fifteen years in Omaha, Nebraska, where he began his legal career at a large regional law firm. After moving to Kansas City, he practiced in large national and international law firms before joining Miller Schirger. Matt lives in Grain Valley, Missouri, with his wife and two children.

attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Lawyers in St. Louis, MO
attorneys.bio:
Grant Mabie is a trial attorney whose practice areas include commercial, real estate, title insurance litigation, landlord-tenant, bankruptcy, collections, and general civil litigation. Grant regularly represents national title insurance underwriters, homeowners, lenders, businesses, landlords, and governmental entities throughout Missouri and Illinois. He has litigated cases in over 35 Missouri counties, in over a dozen Illinois counties, and in the district and bankruptcy courts in the Eastern District of Missouri, the Western District of Missouri, the Southern District of Illinois and the Central District of Illinois. Grant litigates cases including quiet title, reformation of instruments, adverse possession, easement rights and disputes, insurance coverage disputes, breach of contract, lease disputes, unlawful detainer, rent and possession, mechanic’s liens, lien priority disputes, fraud, negligence, trespass, ejectment, zoning and municipal matters, partition, declaratory judgment, breach of warranty, unjust enrichment, indemnity, slander of title, condemnation, eminent domain, abuse of process, injunctive relief, replevin, bankruptcy adversary actions, executions, garnishments, and suits on account. Grant also regularly represents commercial and residential landlords, commercial tenants, medium and small businesses, home buyers, and home sellers with leasing, purchasing, and selling both commercial and residential real property. Grant is a licensed Missouri Real Estate Broker, and a member of the St. Louis Association of Realtors®. Grant has been with Hein Schneider & Bond P.C. since 2010. He previously practiced with a St. Louis law firm in the areas of civil litigation and real estate matters.
